sections.label: Cosmogonical and mystico-theological doctrine
sections.name: Hymn 1

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद् वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेन आवः ।
स बुध्न्याऽउपमाअस्य विष्ठाः सतश्च योनिमसतश्च वि व॥
verses.tr: brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād vi sīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ sa budhnyā'upamāasya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonimasataśca vi va
verses.en: at first the prayer was generated: Vena disclosed bright flashes from the summit, Disclosed his deepest, nearest revelations, womb of the non-existent and existent.

verses.sa:
इयं पित्र्या राष्ट्र्येत्वग्रे प्रथमाय जनुषे भुवनेष्ठाः ।
तस्मा एतं सुरुचं ह्वारमह्यं घर्मं श्रीणन्तु प्रथमाय धास्यवे॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ pitryā rāṣṭryetvagre prathamāya januṣe bhuvaneṣṭhāḥ tasmā etaṃ surucaṃ hvāramahyaṃ gharmaṃ śrīṇantu prathamāya dhāsyave
verses.en: Let this Queen come in front, her Father's daughter, found in the worlds for earliest generation. For him they set this radiant vault in motion. Let them prepare warm milk for him who first would drink.

verses.sa:
प्र यो जज्ञे विद्वानस्य बन्धुर्विश्वा देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति ।
ब्रह्म ब्रह्मण उज्जभार मध्यान्नीचैरुच्चै स्वधा अभि प्र तस्थौ॥
verses.tr: pra yo jajñe vidvānasya bandhurviśvā devānāṃ janimā vivakti brahma brahmaṇa ujjabhāra madhyānnīcairuccai svadhā abhi pra tasthau
verses.en: He who was born as his all-knowing kinsman declareth all the deities' generations. He from the midst of prayer his prayer hath taken. On high, below, spread forth his godlike nature.

verses.sa:
स हि दिवः स पृथिव्या ऋतस्था मही क्षेमं रोदसी अस्कभायत्।
महान् मही अस्कभायद् वि जातो द्यां सद्म पार्थिवं च रज॥
verses.tr: sa hi divaḥ sa pṛthivyā ṛtasthā mahī kṣemaṃ rodasī askabhāyat mahān mahī askabhāyad vi jāto dyāṃ sadma pārthivaṃ ca raja
verses.en: For he, true to the law of Earth and Heaven, established both the mighty worlds securely. Mighty when born, he propped apart the mighty, the sky, our earthly home, and air's mid-region.

verses.sa:
स बुध्न्यादाष्ट्र जनुषोऽभ्यग्रं बृहस्पतिर्देवता तस्य सम्राट्।
अहर्यच्छुक्रं ज्योतिषो जनिष्टाथ द्युमन्तो वि वसन्तु विप्रा॥
verses.tr: sa budhnyādāṣṭra januṣo'bhyagraṃ bṛhaspatirdevatā tasya samrāṭ aharyacchukraṃ jyotiṣo janiṣṭātha dyumanto vi vasantu viprā
verses.en: He from the depth hath been reborn for ever, Brihaspati the world's sole Lord and Ruler. From light was born the Day with all its lustre: through this let sages live endowed with splendour.

verses.sa:
नूनं तदस्य काव्यो हिनोति महो देवस्य पूर्व्यस्य धाम ।
एष जज्ञे बहुभि साकमित्था पूर्वे अर्धे विषिते ससन्नु॥
verses.tr: nūnaṃ tadasya kāvyo hinoti maho devasya pūrvyasya dhāma eṣa jajñe bahubhi sākamitthā pūrve ardhe viṣite sasannu
verses.en: The sage and poet verily advanceth the statute of that mighty God primeval. He was born here with many more beside him: they slumbered when the foremost side was opened.

verses.sa:
योऽथर्वाणं पितरं देवबन्धुं बृहस्पतिं नमसाव च गछात्।
त्वं विश्वेषां जनिता यथास कविर्देवो न दभायत् स्वधावान्॥
verses.tr: yo'tharvāṇaṃ pitaraṃ devabandhuṃ bṛhaspatiṃ namasāva ca gachāt tvaṃ viśveṣāṃ janitā yathāsa kavirdevo na dabhāyat svadhāvān
verses.en: The man who seeks the friend of Gods, Atharvan the father, and Brihaspati, with worship, Crying to him, Be thou all things' creator! the wise God, self-dependent, never injures.

sections.label: To The Unknown God
sections.name: Hymn 2

verses.sa:
य आत्मदा बलदा यस्य विश्व उपासते प्रशिषं यस्य देवाः ।
यो३स्येशे द्विपदो यश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ yo3syeśe dvipado yaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Giver of breath, giver of strength and vigour, he whose commandment all the Gods acknowledge, He who is Lord of this, of man and cattle:—What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यः प्राणतो निमिषतो महित्वैको राजा जगतो बभूव ।
यस्य छायामृतं यस्य मृत्युः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaiko rājā jagato babhūva yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Who by his grandeur hath become sole ruler of all the moving world that breathes and slumbers, Whose shade is death, whose lustre makes immortal:—What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यं क्रन्दसी अवतश्चस्कभाने भियसाने रोदसी अह्वयेथाम्।
यस्यासौ पन्था रजसो विमानः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yaṃ krandasī avataścaskabhāne bhiyasāne rodasī ahvayethām yasyāsau panthā rajaso vimānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: To whom both hosts embattled, look with longing, and Heaven and Earth invoke him in their terror; Whose is this path that measures out the region:—What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यस्य द्यौरुर्वी पृथिवी च मही यस्याद उर्व१न्तरिक्षम्।
यस्यासौ सूरो विततो महित्वा कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yasya dyaururvī pṛthivī ca mahī yasyāda urva1ntarikṣam yasyāsau sūro vitato mahitvā kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Whose is the mighty earth and spacious heaven, and yonder ample firmament between them, Whose is yon Sun extended in his grandeur:—What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यस्य विश्वे हिमवन्तो महित्वा समुद्रे यस्य रसामिदाहुः ।
इमाश्च प्रदिशो यस्य बाहू कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yasya viśve himavanto mahitvā samudre yasya rasāmidāhuḥ imāśca pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Whose, through his might, are all the Snowy Mountains, and whose, they say is Rasa in the ocean, The arms of whom are these celestial quarters:—What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
आपो अग्रे विश्वमावन् गर्भं दधाना अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
यासु देवीष्वधि देव आसीत् कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: āpo agre viśvamāvan garbhaṃ dadhānā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ yāsu devīṣvadhi deva āsīt kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: The deathless Waters, born in Law, receiving, protected all the germ in the beginning,—Waters divine who had the God above them: What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत्।
स दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्यां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt sa dādhāra pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, even at his birth sole Lord of all creation. He fixt and firmly stablished earth and heaven:—What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
आपो वत्सं जनयन्तीर्गर्भमग्रे समैरयन्।
तस्योत जायमानस्योल्ब आसीद्धिरण्ययः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: āpo vatsaṃ janayantīrgarbhamagre samairayan tasyota jāyamānasyolba āsīddhiraṇyayaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: In the beginning, generating offspring, the Waters brought an embryo into being; And even as it sprang to life it had a covering of gold.

sections.label: A charm against tigers, wolves, thieves, and other noxious creatures
sections.name: Hymn 3

verses.sa:
उदितस्त्रयो अक्रमन् व्याघ्रः पुरुषो वृकः ।
हिरुग्घि यन्ति सिन्धवो हिरुग् देवो वनस्पतिर्हिरुङ्नमन्तु शत्रवः॥
verses.tr: uditastrayo akraman vyāghraḥ puruṣo vṛkaḥ hirugghi yanti sindhavo hirug devo vanaspatirhiruṅnamantu śatravaḥ
verses.en: Three have gone hence and passed away, the man, the tiger, and the wolf. Down, verily, the rivers flow, down-goeth the celestial Tree, down let our foemen bend and bow.

verses.sa:
परेणैतु पथा वृकः परमेणोत तस्करः ।
परेण दत्वती रज्जुः परेणाघायुरर्षतु॥
verses.tr: pareṇaitu pathā vṛkaḥ parameṇota taskaraḥ pareṇa datvatī rajjuḥ pareṇāghāyurarṣatu
verses.en: On distant pathway go the wolf, on pathway most remote the thief! i On a far road speed forth the rope with teeth, and the malicious man!

verses.sa:
अक्ष्यौऽच ते मुखं च ते व्याघ्र जम्भयामसि ।
आत् सर्वान् विंशतिं नखान्॥
verses.tr: akṣyau'ca te mukhaṃ ca te vyāghra jambhayāmasi āt sarvān viṃśatiṃ nakhān
verses.en: We crush and rend to pieces both thine eyes, O Tiger, and thy jaws, and all the twenty claws we break.

verses.sa:
व्याघ्रं दत्वतां वयं प्रथमं जम्भयामसि ।
आदु ष्टेनमथो अहिं यातुधानमथो वृकम्॥
verses.tr: vyāghraṃ datvatāṃ vayaṃ prathamaṃ jambhayāmasi ādu ṣṭenamatho ahiṃ yātudhānamatho vṛkam
verses.en: We break and rend the tiger first of creatures that are armed with teeth; The robber then, and then the snake, the sorcerer, and then the wolf.

verses.sa:
यो अद्य स्तेन आयति स संपिष्टो अपायति ।
पथामपध्वंसेनैत्विन्द्रो वज्रेण हन्तु तम्॥
verses.tr: yo adya stena āyati sa saṃpiṣṭo apāyati pathāmapadhvaṃsenaitvindro vajreṇa hantu tam
verses.en: The thief who cometh near to-day departeth bruised and crushed to bits. By nearest way let him be gone. Let Indra slay him with his bolt.

verses.sa:
मूर्णा मृगस्य दन्ता अपिशीर्णा उ पृष्टयः ।
निम्रुक्ते गोधा भवतु नीचायच्छशयुर्मृगः॥
verses.tr: mūrṇā mṛgasya dantā apiśīrṇā u pṛṣṭayaḥ nimrukte godhā bhavatu nīcāyacchaśayurmṛgaḥ
verses.en: Let the beast's teeth be broken off, shivered and shattered be his ribs! Slack be thy bowstring: downward go the wild beast that pursues the hare!

verses.sa:
यत् संयमो न वि यमो वि यमो यन्न संयमः ।
इन्द्रजाः सोमजा आथर्वणमसि व्याघ्रजम्भनम्॥
verses.tr: yat saṃyamo na vi yamo vi yamo yanna saṃyamaḥ indrajāḥ somajā ātharvaṇamasi vyāghrajambhanam
verses.en: Open not what thou hast compressed, close not what thou hast not compressed. Indra's and Soma's child, thou art Atharvan's tiger-crushing charm.

sections.label: A charm to restore virile power
sections.name: Hymn 4

verses.sa:
यां त्वा गन्धर्वो अखनद् वरुणाय मृतभ्रजे ।
तां त्वा वयं खनामस्योषधिं शेपहर्षणीम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ tvā gandharvo akhanad varuṇāya mṛtabhraje tāṃ tvā vayaṃ khanāmasyoṣadhiṃ śepaharṣaṇīm
verses.en: We dig thee from the earth, the Plant which strengthens and exalts the nerves, The Plant which the Gandharva dug for Varuna whose power was lost.

verses.sa:
उदुषा उदु सूर्य उदिदं मामकं वचः ।
उदेजतु प्रजापतिर्वृषा शुष्मेण वाजिना॥
verses.tr: uduṣā udu sūrya udidaṃ māmakaṃ vacaḥ udejatu prajāpatirvṛṣā śuṣmeṇa vājinā
verses.en: Let Ushas and let Surya rise, let this the speech I utter rise. Let the strong male. Prajapati arise with manly energy.

verses.sa:
यथा स्म ते विरोहतोऽभितप्तमिवानति ।
ततस्ते शुष्मवत्तरमियं कृणोत्वोषधिः॥
उच्छुष्मौषधीनां सार ऋषभाणाम्।
सं पुंसामिन्द्र वृष्ण्यमस्मिन्धेहि तनूवशिन्॥
अपां रसः प्रथमजोऽथो वनस्पतीनाम्।
उत सोमस्य भ्रातास्युतार्शमसि वृष्ण्यम्॥
अद्याग्ने अद्य सवितरद्य देवि सरस्वति ।
अद्यास्य ब्रह्मणस्पते धनुरिवा तानया पसः॥
आहं तनोमि ते पसो अधि ज्यामिव धन्वनि ।
क्रमस्वर्श इव रोहितमनवग्लायता सदा॥
अश्वस्याश्वतरस्याजस्य पेत्वस्य च ।
अथ ऋषभस्य ये वाजास्तानस्मिन्धेहि तनूवशिन्॥
verses.tr: yathā sma te virohato'bhitaptamivānati tataste śuṣmavattaramiyaṃ kṛṇotvoṣadhiḥ ucchuṣmauṣadhīnāṃ sāra ṛṣabhāṇām saṃ puṃsāmindra vṛṣṇyamasmindhehi tanūvaśin apāṃ rasaḥ prathamajo'tho vanaspatīnām uta somasya bhrātāsyutārśamasi vṛṣṇyam adyāgne adya savitaradya devi sarasvati adyāsya brahmaṇaspate dhanurivā tānayā pasaḥ āhaṃ tanomi te paso adhi jyāmiva dhanvani kramasvarśa iva rohitamanavaglāyatā sadā aśvasyāśvatarasyājasya petvasya ca atha ṛṣabhasya ye vājāstānasmindhehi tanūvaśin
verses.en: [Griffith gives stanzas 3 to the end only in a Latin version, in the Appendix to his translation.]

sections.label: The lullaby or sleep-charm
sections.name: Hymn 5

verses.sa:
सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभो यः समुद्रादुदाचरत्।
तेना सहस्येऽना वयं नि जनान्त्स्वापयामसि॥
verses.tr: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho yaḥ samudrādudācarat tenā sahasye'nā vayaṃ ni janāntsvāpayāmasi
verses.en: The Bull who hath a thousand horns, who rises up from out the sea,—. By him the strong and mighty one we lull the folk to rest and sleep.

verses.sa:
न भूमिं वातो अति वाति नाति पश्यति कश्चन।
स्त्रियश्च सर्वाः स्वापय शुनश्चेन्द्रसखा चरन्॥
verses.tr: na bhūmiṃ vāto ati vāti nāti paśyati kaścana striyaśca sarvāḥ svāpaya śunaścendrasakhā caran
verses.en: Over the surface of the earth there breathes no wind, there looks no eye. Lull all the women, lull the dogs to sleep, with Indra as thy friend!

verses.sa:
प्रोष्ठेशयास्तल्पेशया नारीर्या वह्यशीवरीः ।
स्त्रियो याः पुण्यगन्धयस्ताः सर्वाः स्वापयामसि॥
verses.tr: proṣṭheśayāstalpeśayā nārīryā vahyaśīvarīḥ striyo yāḥ puṇyagandhayastāḥ sarvāḥ svāpayāmasi
verses.en: The women sleeping in the court, lying without, or stretched on beds, The matrons with their odorous sweets—these, one and all, we lull to sleep.

verses.sa:
एजदेजदजग्रभं चक्षुः प्राणमजग्रभम्।
अङ्गान्यजग्रभं सर्वा रात्रीणामतिशर्वरे॥
verses.tr: ejadejadajagrabhaṃ cakṣuḥ prāṇamajagrabham aṅgānyajagrabhaṃ sarvā rātrīṇāmatiśarvare
verses.en: Each moving thing have I secured, have held and hold the eye and breath. Each limb and member have I seized in the deep darkness of the night.

verses.sa:
य आस्ते यश्चरति यश्च तिष्ठन्विपश्यति ।
तेषां सं दध्मो अक्षीणि यथेदं हर्म्यं तथा॥
verses.tr: ya āste yaścarati yaśca tiṣṭhanvipaśyati teṣāṃ saṃ dadhmo akṣīṇi yathedaṃ harmyaṃ tathā
verses.en: The man who sits, the man who walks, whoever stands and clearly sees—Of these we closely shut the eyes, even as we closely shut this house.

verses.sa:
स्वप्तु माता स्वप्तु पिता स्वप्तु श्वा स्वप्तु विश्पतिः ।
स्वपन्त्वस्यै ज्ञातयः स्वप्त्वयमभितो जनः॥
verses.tr: svaptu mātā svaptu pitā svaptu śvā svaptu viśpatiḥ svapantvasyai jñātayaḥ svaptvayamabhito janaḥ
verses.en: Sleep mother, let the father sleep, sleep dog, and master of the home. Let all her kinsmen sleep, sleep all the people who are round about.

verses.sa:
स्वप्न स्वप्नाभिकरणेन सर्वं नि स्वापया जनम्।
ओत्सूर्यमन्यान्त्स्वापयाव्युषं जागृतादहमिन्द्र इवारिष्टो अक्षितः॥
verses.tr: svapna svapnābhikaraṇena sarvaṃ ni svāpayā janam otsūryamanyāntsvāpayāvyuṣaṃ jāgṛtādahamindra ivāriṣṭo akṣitaḥ
verses.en: With soporific charm, O Sleep, lull thou to slumber all the folk, Let 'the rest sleep till break of day, I will remain awake till dawn, like Indra free from scath and harm.

sections.label: A charm to make a poisoned arrow harmless
sections.name: Hymn 6

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणो जज्ञे प्रथमो दशशीर्षो दशास्यः ।
स सोमं प्रथमः पपौ स चकारारसं विषम्॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇo jajñe prathamo daśaśīrṣo daśāsyaḥ sa somaṃ prathamaḥ papau sa cakārārasaṃ viṣam
verses.en: The Brahman first was brought to life ber- headed and with faces ten. First drinker of the Soma, he made poison ineffectual.

verses.sa:
यावती द्यावापृथिवी वरिम्णा यावत् सप्त सिन्धवो वितष्ठिरे।
वाचं विषस्य दूषणीं तामितो निरवादिषम्॥
verses.tr: yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī varimṇā yāvat sapta sindhavo vitaṣṭhire vācaṃ viṣasya dūṣaṇīṃ tāmito niravādiṣam
verses.en: Far as the heavens and earth are spread in compass, far as the Seven Rivers are extended, So far my spell, the antidote of poison, have I spoken hence.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णस्त्वा गरुत्मान्विष प्रथममावयत्।
नामीमदो नारूरुप उतास्मा अभवः पितुः॥
verses.tr: suparṇastvā garutmānviṣa prathamamāvayat nāmīmado nārūrupa utāsmā abhavaḥ pituḥ
verses.en: The strong-winged Bird Garutman first of all, O Poison, fed on thee: Thou didst not gripe or make him drunk: aye, thou becamest food for him.

verses.sa:
यस्त आस्यत् पञ्चाङ्गुरिर्वक्राच्चिदधि धन्वनः ।
अपस्कम्भस्य शल्यान्निरवोचमहं विषम्॥
verses.tr: yasta āsyat pañcāṅgurirvakrāccidadhi dhanvanaḥ apaskambhasya śalyānniravocamahaṃ viṣam
verses.en: Whoever with five fingers hath discharged thee from the crooked bow, I from the shaft have charmed away the poison of the fastening band.

verses.sa:
शल्याद्विषं निरवोचं प्राञ्जनादुत पर्णधेः ।
अपाष्ठाच्छृङ्गात्कुल्मलान्निरवोचमहं विषम्॥
verses.tr: śalyādviṣaṃ niravocaṃ prāñjanāduta parṇadheḥ apāṣṭhācchṛṅgātkulmalānniravocamahaṃ viṣam
verses.en: The poison have I charmed away from shaft, cement, and feathered end; Yea, from the barb, the neck, the horn, the poison have I charmed away.

verses.sa:
अरसस्त इषो शल्योऽथो ते अरसं विषम्।
उतारसस्य वृक्षस्य धनुष्टे अरसारसम्॥
verses.tr: arasasta iṣo śalyo'tho te arasaṃ viṣam utārasasya vṛkṣasya dhanuṣṭe arasārasam
verses.en: Feeble, O Arrow, is thy shaft, thy poison, too, hath lost its strength. Made of a worthless tree, thy bow, O feeble one, is impotent.

verses.sa:
ये अपीषन् ये अदिहन् य आस्यन् ये अवासृजन्।
सर्वे ते वध्रयः कृता वध्रिर्विषगिरिः कृतः॥
verses.tr: ye apīṣan ye adihan ya āsyan ye avāsṛjan sarve te vadhrayaḥ kṛtā vadhrirviṣagiriḥ kṛtaḥ
verses.en: The men who brayed it, smeared it on, they who discharged it, sent it forth, All these are made emasculate, emasculate the poison-hill.

verses.sa:
वध्रयस्ते खनितारो वध्रिस्त्वमस्योषधे ।
वध्रिः स पर्वतो गिरिर्यतो जातमिदं विषम्॥
verses.tr: vadhrayaste khanitāro vadhristvamasyoṣadhe vadhriḥ sa parvato giriryato jātamidaṃ viṣam
verses.en: Thy diggers are emasculate, emasculate, O Plant, art thou. The rugged mountain that produced this poison is emasculate.

sections.label: A charm to make a poisonous plant innocuous
sections.name: Hymn 7

verses.sa:
वारिदं वारयातै वरणावत्यामधि ।
तत्रामृतस्यासिक्त तेना ते वारये विषम्॥
verses.tr: vāridaṃ vārayātai varaṇāvatyāmadhi tatrāmṛtasyāsikta tenā te vāraye viṣam
verses.en: So may this water guard us on the bank of Varanavati. Therein hath Amrit been infused: with that I ward thy poison off.

verses.sa:
अरसं प्राच्यंऽविषमरसं यदुदीच्यऽम्।
अथेदमधराच्यं करम्भेण वि कल्पते॥
verses.tr: arasaṃ prācyaṃ'viṣamarasaṃ yadudīcya'm athedamadharācyaṃ karambheṇa vi kalpate
verses.en: Weak is the poison of the East, weak is s the poison of the North, So too this poison of the South counts as a, cake of curds and meal.

verses.sa:
करम्भं कृत्वा तिर्यंऽपीबस्पाकमुदारथिम्।
क्षुधा किल त्वा दुष्टनो जक्षिवान्त्स न रूरुपः॥
verses.tr: karambhaṃ kṛtvā tiryaṃ'pībaspākamudārathim kṣudhā kila tvā duṣṭano jakṣivāntsa na rūrupaḥ
verses.en: When he hath made of thee a cake, broad, steaming, swelling up with fat, And even in hunger eaten thee, then gripe him not, thou hideous one!

verses.sa:
वि ते मदं मदावति शरमिव पातयामसि ।
प्र त्वा चरुमिव येषन्तं वचसा स्थापयामसि॥
verses.tr: vi te madaṃ madāvati śaramiva pātayāmasi pra tvā carumiva yeṣantaṃ vacasā sthāpayāmasi
verses.en: Intoxicater! like a shaft we make thy spirit fly away, Like a pot boiling on the fire, we with our word remove thee hence.

verses.sa:
परि ग्राममिवाचितं वचसा स्थापयामसि ।
तिष्ठा वृक्ष इव स्थाम्न्यभ्रिखाते न रूरुपः॥
verses.tr: pari grāmamivācitaṃ vacasā sthāpayāmasi tiṣṭhā vṛkṣa iva sthāmnyabhrikhāte na rūrupaḥ
verses.en: We set around thee with the spell as 'twere a gathered armament. Stay quiet like a rooted tree. Dug up with mattocks, gripe not thou.

verses.sa:
पवस्तैस्त्वा पर्यक्रीणन् दूर्शेभिरजिनैरुत।
प्रक्रीरसि त्वमोषधेऽभ्रिखाते न रूरुपः॥
verses.tr: pavastaistvā paryakrīṇan dūrśebhirajinairuta prakrīrasi tvamoṣadhe'bhrikhāte na rūrupaḥ
verses.en: For coverings men have bartered thee, for skins of deer and woven cloths. Thou art a thing of sale, O Plant. Dug up with mattocks, gripe not thou!

verses.sa:
अनाप्ता ये वः प्रथमा यानि कर्माणि चक्रिरे।
वीरान्नो अत्र मा दभन् तद् व एतत्पुरो दधे॥
verses.tr: anāptā ye vaḥ prathamā yāni karmāṇi cakrire vīrānno atra mā dabhan tad va etatpuro dadhe
verses.en: None have attained to those of old, those who wrought holy acts for you. Let them not harm our heroes here. Therefore I set before you this.

sections.label: A benediction at the consecration of a King
sections.name: Hymn 8

verses.sa:
भूतो भूतेषु पय आ दधाति स भूतानामधिपतिर्बभूव ।
तस्य मृत्युश्चरति राजसूयं स राजा राज्यमनु मन्यतामिदम्॥
verses.tr: bhūto bhūteṣu paya ā dadhāti sa bhūtānāmadhipatirbabhūva tasya mṛtyuścarati rājasūyaṃ sa rājā rājyamanu manyatāmidam
verses.en: The Being lays the sap of life in beings: he hath become the sovran Lord of creatures. Death comes to this man's royal consecration: let him as King own and allow this kingdom.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रेहि माप वेन उग्रश्चेत्ता सपत्नहा।
आ तिष्ठ मित्रवर्धन तुभ्यं देवा अधि ब्रुवन्॥
verses.tr: abhi prehi māpa vena ugraścettā sapatnahā ā tiṣṭha mitravardhana tubhyaṃ devā adhi bruvan
verses.en: Come forward, turn not back in scorn, strong guardian, slayer of the foes. Approach, O gladdener of thy friends. The Gods have blessed and d i thee.

verses.sa:
आतिष्ठन्तं परि विश्वे अभूषंछ्रियं वसानश्चरति स्वरोचिः ।
महत् तद् वृष्णो असुरस्य नामा विश्वरूपो अमृतानि तस्थौ॥
verses.tr: ātiṣṭhantaṃ pari viśve abhūṣaṃchriyaṃ vasānaścarati svarociḥ mahat tad vṛṣṇo asurasya nāmā viśvarūpo amṛtāni tasthau
verses.en: All waited on him as he came to meet them. He self-resplendent moves endued with glory. That is the royal hero's lofty nature: he, manifold, hath gained immortal powers.

verses.sa:
व्याघ्रो अधि वैयाघ्रे वि क्रमस्व दिशो महीः ।
विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्त्वापो दिव्याः पयस्वतीः॥
verses.tr: vyāghro adhi vaiyāghre vi kramasva diśo mahīḥ viśastvā sarvā vāñchantvāpo divyāḥ payasvatīḥ
verses.en: Stride forth to heaven's broad regions, thou, a tiger on a tiger's skin. Let all the people long for thee. Let heavenly floods be rich in milk.

verses.sa:
या आपो दिव्याः पयसा मदन्त्यन्तरिक्ष उत वा पृथिव्याम्।
तासां त्वा सर्वासामपामभि षिञ्चामि वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: yā āpo divyāḥ payasā madantyantarikṣa uta vā pṛthivyām tāsāṃ tvā sarvāsāmapāmabhi ṣiñcāmi varcasā
verses.en: Heaven's waters joyous in their milk, the waters of middle air, and those that earth containeth—I with the gathered power and might of all these waters sprinkle thee.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा वर्चसासिचन्नापो दिव्याः पयस्वतीः ।
यथासो मित्रवर्धनस्तथा त्वा सविता करत्॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā varcasāsicannāpo divyāḥ payasvatīḥ yathāso mitravardhanastathā tvā savitā karat
verses.en: The heavenly waters rich in milk have sprinkled thee with power and might. To be the gladdener of thy friends. May Savitar so fashion thee.

verses.sa:
एना व्याघ्रं परिषस्वजानाः सिंहं हिन्वन्ति महते सौभगाय ।
समुद्रं न सुभुवस्तस्थिवांसं मर्मृज्यन्ते द्वीपिनमप्स्व१न्तः॥
verses.tr: enā vyāghraṃ pariṣasvajānāḥ siṃhaṃ hinvanti mahate saubhagāya samudraṃ na subhuvastasthivāṃsaṃ marmṛjyante dvīpinamapsva1ntaḥ
verses.en: These, compassing the tiger, rouse the lion to great joy and bliss. As strong floods purify the standing ocean, so men adorn the leopard in the waters.

sections.label: A charm addressed to a precious ointment for safety and wealth
sections.name: Hymn 9

verses.sa:
एहि जीवं त्रायमाणं पर्वतस्यास्यक्ष्यम्।
विश्वेभिर्देवैर्दत्तं परिधिर्जीवनाय कम्॥
verses.tr: ehi jīvaṃ trāyamāṇaṃ parvatasyāsyakṣyam viśvebhirdevairdattaṃ paridhirjīvanāya kam
verses.en: APPRoACH! thou art the mountain's eye, the living thing that saveth us; A gift bestowed by all the Gods, yea, the defence that guardeth life.

verses.sa:
परिपाणं पुरुषाणां परिपाणं गवामसि ।
अश्वानामर्वतां परिपाणाय तस्थिषे॥
verses.tr: paripāṇaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ paripāṇaṃ gavāmasi aśvānāmarvatāṃ paripāṇāya tasthiṣe
verses.en: Thou art the safeguard of the men, thou art the safeguard of the kine, Thou standest ready to protect the horses that are fleet of foot.

verses.sa:
उतासि परिपाणं यातुजम्भनमाञ्जन ।
उतामृतस्य त्वं वेत्थाथो असि जीवभोजनमथो हरितभेषजम्॥
verses.tr: utāsi paripāṇaṃ yātujambhanamāñjana utāmṛtasya tvaṃ vetthātho asi jīvabhojanamatho haritabheṣajam
verses.en: Thou, also, Salve! art a defence that rends and crushes sorcerers. Thou knowest, too, of Amrit, thou art the delight of all who live, a jaundice-curing balm art thou. Whomso

verses.sa:
यस्याञ्जन प्रसर्पस्यङ्गमङ्गं परुष्परुः ।
ततो यक्ष्मं वि बाधस उग्रो मध्यमशीरिव॥
verses.tr: yasyāñjana prasarpasyaṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣparuḥ tato yakṣmaṃ vi bādhasa ugro madhyamaśīriva
verses.en: thou creepest over, Salve! member by member, joint by joint, From him, like some strong arbiter of strife, thou banishest decline.

verses.sa:
नैनं प्राप्नोति शपथो न कृत्या नाभिशोचनम्।
नैनं विष्कन्धमश्नुते यस्त्वा बिभर्त्याञ्जन॥
verses.tr: nainaṃ prāpnoti śapatho na kṛtyā nābhiśocanam nainaṃ viṣkandhamaśnute yastvā bibhartyāñjana
verses.en: No imprecation reaches him, no magic, no tormenting fiend, O Salve, Vishkandha seizes not the man who carries thee about.

verses.sa:
असन्मन्त्राद् दुष्वप्न्याद् दुष्कृताच्छमलादुत।
दुर्हार्दश्चक्षुषो घोरात् तस्मान्नः पाह्याञ्जन॥
verses.tr: asanmantrād duṣvapnyād duṣkṛtācchamalāduta durhārdaścakṣuṣo ghorāt tasmānnaḥ pāhyāñjana
verses.en: From lying speech, from evil dream, from wicked act and sinfulness, From hostile and malignant eye,—from these, O Salve, protect us well.

verses.sa:
इदं विद्वानाञ्जन सत्यं वक्ष्यामि नानृतम्।
सनेयमश्वं गामहमात्मानं तव पूरुष॥
verses.tr: idaṃ vidvānāñjana satyaṃ vakṣyāmi nānṛtam saneyamaśvaṃ gāmahamātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa
verses.en: I, knowing this, O Salve, will speak the very truth and not a lie: May I obtain both horse and ox, may I obtain thy life, O man.

verses.sa:
त्रयो दासा आञ्जनस्य तक्मा बलास आदहिः ।
वर्षिष्ठः पर्वतानां त्रिककुन्नाम ते पिता॥
verses.tr: trayo dāsā āñjanasya takmā balāsa ādahiḥ varṣiṣṭhaḥ parvatānāṃ trikakunnāma te pitā
verses.en: Three are the slaves that serve the Salve, Fever, Consumption, and the Snake. Thy father is the loftiest of mountains, named the Triple-peaked.

verses.sa:
यदाञ्जनं त्रैककुदं जातं हिमवतस्परि ।
यातूंश्च सर्वाञ्जम्भयत् सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः॥
verses.tr: yadāñjanaṃ traikakudaṃ jātaṃ himavataspari yātūṃśca sarvāñjambhayat sarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ
verses.en: Sprung from the Snowy Mountain's side, this Ointment of the Three-peaked hill. Crushes and rends all sorcerers and every witch and sorceress.

verses.sa:
यदि वासि त्रैककुदं यदि यामुनमुच्यसे ।
उभे ते भद्रे नाम्नी ताभ्यां नः पाह्याञ्जन॥
verses.tr: yadi vāsi traikakudaṃ yadi yāmunamucyase ubhe te bhadre nāmnī tābhyāṃ naḥ pāhyāñjana
verses.en: If thou art from the Three-peaked hill or hast thy name from Yamuna, These names are both auspicious: by these two protect thou us, O Salve! J

sections.label: A charm accompanying investiture with a protective amulet of shell
sections.name: Hymn 10

verses.sa:
वाताज्जातो अन्तरिक्षाद् विद्युतो ज्योतिषस्परि ।
स नो हिरण्यजाः शङ्खः कृशनः पात्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: vātājjāto antarikṣād vidyuto jyotiṣaspari sa no hiraṇyajāḥ śaṅkhaḥ kṛśanaḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Child of the wind and firmament, sprung from the. lightning and the light, May this the gold-born Shell that bears the pearl preserve us from distress.

verses.sa:
यो अग्रतो रोचनानां समुद्रादधि जज्ञिषे।
शङ्खेन हत्वा रक्षांस्यत्त्रिणो वि षहामहे॥
verses.tr: yo agrato rocanānāṃ samudrādadhi jajñiṣe śaṅkhena hatvā rakṣāṃsyattriṇo vi ṣahāmahe
verses.en: Shell that wast born from out the sea, set at the head of things that shine! With thee we slay the Rakshasas and overcome voracious fiends.

verses.sa:
शङ्खेनामीवाममतिं शङ्खेनोत सदान्वाः ।
शङ्खो नो विश्वभेषजः कृशनः पात्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: śaṅkhenāmīvāmamatiṃ śaṅkhenota sadānvāḥ śaṅkho no viśvabheṣajaḥ kṛśanaḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: We stay disease and indigence, and chase Sadanvas with the Shell. May the all-healing Shell that bears the pearl preserve us from distress.

verses.sa:
दिवि जातः समुद्रजः सिन्धुतस्पर्याभृतः ।
स नो हिरण्यजाः शङ्ख आयुष्प्रतरणो मणिः॥
verses.tr: divi jātaḥ samudrajaḥ sindhutasparyābhṛtaḥ sa no hiraṇyajāḥ śaṅkha āyuṣprataraṇo maṇiḥ
verses.en: Born in the heaven, sprung from the sea, brought to us hither from the flood, This gold-born Shell shall be to us an amulet to lengthen life.

verses.sa:
समुद्राज्जातो मणिर्वृत्राज्जातो दिवाकरः ।
सो अस्मान्त्सर्वतः पातु हेत्या देवासुरेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: samudrājjāto maṇirvṛtrājjāto divākaraḥ so asmāntsarvataḥ pātu hetyā devāsurebhyaḥ
verses.en: From ocean sprang the Amulet, from Vritra sprang the Lord of Day: May this protect us round about from shaft of God and Asura.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यानामेकोऽसि सोमात् त्वमधि जज्ञिषे ।
रथे त्वमसि दर्शत इषुधौ रोचनस्त्वं प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyānāmeko'si somāt tvamadhi jajñiṣe rathe tvamasi darśata iṣudhau rocanastvaṃ pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
verses.en: Peerless 'mid golden ornaments art thou: from Soma wast thou born. Thou gleamest on the quiver, thou art beautiful upon the car: may it prolong our days of life!

verses.sa:
देवानामस्थि कृशनं बभूव तदात्मन्वच्चरत्यप्स्व१न्तः ।
तत् ते बध्नाम्यायुषे वर्चसे बलाय दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय कार्शनस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: devānāmasthi kṛśanaṃ babhūva tadātmanvaccaratyapsva1ntaḥ tat te badhnāmyāyuṣe varcase balāya dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya kārśanastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: Bone of the Gods became the pearl's shell-mother: endowed with soul it moveth in the waters. I bind this on thee for life, strength, and vigour, for long life lasting through a hundred autumns. May the pearl's mother keep and guard thee safely! J

sections.label: A glorification of the Gharma or Caldron in which the libation of hot
sections.name: Hymn 11

verses.sa:
अनड्वान् दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्यामनड्वान् दाधारोर्व१न्तरिक्षम्।
अनड्वान् दाधार प्रदिशः षडुर्वीरनड्वान् विश्वं भुवनमा विवेश॥
verses.tr: anaḍvān dādhāra pṛthivīmuta dyāmanaḍvān dādhārorva1ntarikṣam anaḍvān dādhāra pradiśaḥ ṣaḍurvīranaḍvān viśvaṃ bhuvanamā viveśa
verses.en: The Bull supports the wide-spread earth and heaven. The Bull supports the spacious air between them. The Bull supports the sky's six spacious regions: the universal world hath he pervaded.

verses.sa:
अनड्वानिन्द्रः स पशुभ्यो वि चष्टे त्रयां छक्रो वि मिमीते अध्वनः ।
भूतं भविष्यद् भुवना दुहानः सर्वा देवानां चरति व्रतानि॥
verses.tr: anaḍvānindraḥ sa paśubhyo vi caṣṭe trayāṃ chakro vi mimīte adhvanaḥ bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyad bhuvanā duhānaḥ sarvā devānāṃ carati vratāni
verses.en: The Bull is Indra: o'er the beasts he watches. He, Sakra, measures out three several pathways. He, milking out the worlds, the past, the future, discharges all the Gods' eternal duties.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो जातो मनुष्येऽष्वन्तर्घर्मस्तप्तश्चरति शोशुचानः ।
सुप्रजाः सन्त्स उदारे न सर्षद्यो नाश्नीयादनडुहो विजानन्॥
verses.tr: indro jāto manuṣye'ṣvantargharmastaptaścarati śośucānaḥ suprajāḥ santsa udāre na sarṣadyo nāśnīyādanaḍuho vijānan
verses.en: Being produced among mankind as Indra, the Caldron works heated and brightly glowing. Let him not, with good sons, pass off in vapour who hath not eaten of the Ox with knowledge.

verses.sa:
अनड्वान् दुहे सुकृतस्य लोक ऐनं प्याययति पवमानः पुरस्तात्।
पर्जन्यो धारा मरुत ऊधो अस्य यज्ञः पयो दक्षिणा दोहो अस्य॥
verses.tr: anaḍvān duhe sukṛtasya loka ainaṃ pyāyayati pavamānaḥ purastāt parjanyo dhārā maruta ūdho asya yajñaḥ payo dakṣiṇā doho asya
verses.en: The Ox pours milk out in the world of virtue: in earliest time, he, Pavamana, swells it. Parjanya is the stream, Maruts his udder, sacrifice is the milk, the meed his milking.

verses.sa:
यस्य नेशे यज्ञपतिर्न यज्ञो नास्य दातेशे न प्रतिग्रहीता।
यो विश्वजिद् विश्वभृद् विश्कर्मा घर्मं नो ब्रूत यतमश्चतुष्पात्॥
verses.tr: yasya neśe yajñapatirna yajño nāsya dāteśe na pratigrahītā yo viśvajid viśvabhṛd viśkarmā gharmaṃ no brūta yatamaścatuṣpāt
verses.en: That which not sacrifice nor sacrificer, not giver nor receiver rules and governs, All-winning, all-supporting, all-effecting,—which of all quadrupeds, tell us! is the Caldron?

verses.sa:
येन देवाः स्वरारुरुहुर्हित्वा शरीरममृतस्य नाभिम्।
तेन गेष्म सुकृतस्य लोकं घर्मस्य व्रतेन तपसा यशस्यवः॥
verses.tr: yena devāḥ svarāruruhurhitvā śarīramamṛtasya nābhim tena geṣma sukṛtasya lokaṃ gharmasya vratena tapasā yaśasyavaḥ
verses.en: May we, fame-seekers, reach the world of virtue by service of the Gharma and through fervour, Whereby the Gods went up to heaven, the centre of life eternal, having left the body.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो रूपेणाग्निर्वहेन प्रजापतिः परमेष्ठी विराट्।
विश्वानरे अक्रमत वैश्वानरे अक्रमतानदुह्यक्रमत । सोऽदृंहयत सोऽधारयत॥
verses.tr: indro rūpeṇāgnirvahena prajāpatiḥ parameṣṭhī virāṭ viśvānare akramata vaiśvānare akramatānaduhyakramata so'dṛṃhayata so'dhārayata
verses.en: Prajapati, supreme and sovran ruler, Indra by form and by his shoulder Agni, Came to Visvanara, came to all men's Bullock: he firmly fortified and held securely.

verses.sa:
मध्यमेतदनडुहो यत्रैष वह आहितः ।
एतावदस्य प्राचीनं यावान् प्रत्यङ् समाहितः॥
verses.tr: madhyametadanaḍuho yatraiṣa vaha āhitaḥ etāvadasya prācīnaṃ yāvān pratyaṅ samāhitaḥ
verses.en: The middle of the Bullock's neck, there where the shoulder-bar is placed, Extends as far to east of him as that i is settled to the west.

verses.sa:
यो वेदानडुहो दोहान्त्सप्तानुपदस्वतः ।
प्रजां च लोकं चाप्नोति तथा सप्तऋषयो विदुः॥
verses.tr: yo vedānaḍuho dohāntsaptānupadasvataḥ prajāṃ ca lokaṃ cāpnoti tathā saptaṛṣayo viduḥ
verses.en: He whosoever knows the seven exhaustless pourings of the Ox, Wins himself offspring and the world: the great Seven Rishis know this well.

verses.sa:
पद्भिः सेदिमवक्रामन्निरां जङ्घाभिरुत्खिदन्।
श्रमेणानड्वान् कीलालं कीनाशश्चाभि गच्छतः॥
verses.tr: padbhiḥ sedimavakrāmannirāṃ jaṅghābhirutkhidan śrameṇānaḍvān kīlālaṃ kīnāśaścābhi gacchataḥ
verses.en: With feet subduing weariness, with legs extracting freshening draughts, Through toil the plougher and the Ox approach the honeyed beverage.

verses.sa:
द्वादश वा एता रात्रीर्व्रत्या आहुः प्रजापतेः ।
तत्रोप ब्रह्म यो वेद तद् वा अनडुहो व्रतम्॥
verses.tr: dvādaśa vā etā rātrīrvratyā āhuḥ prajāpateḥ tatropa brahma yo veda tad vā anaḍuho vratam
verses.en: Assigned are these twelve nights, they say, as holy to Prajapati: Whoever knows their proper prayer performs the service of the Ox.

verses.sa:
दुहे सायं दुहे प्रातर्दुहे मध्यंदिनं परि ।
दोहा ये अस्य संयन्ति तान् विद्मानुपदस्वतः॥
verses.tr: duhe sāyaṃ duhe prātarduhe madhyaṃdinaṃ pari dohā ye asya saṃyanti tān vidmānupadasvataḥ
verses.en: At evening he is milked, is milked at early morn, is milked at noon. We know that streams of milk that flow from him are inexhaustible.

sections.label: A charm to mend a broken bone
sections.name: Hymn 12

verses.en: Thou art the healer, making whole, the healer of the broken bone: Make thou this whole, Arundhati!
Whatever bone of thine within thy body hath been wrenched or cracked, May Dhatar set it properly, and join together limb by limb.
With marrow be the marrow joined, thy limb united with the limb. Let what hath fallen of thy flesh, and the bone also, grow again.
Let marrow close with marrow, let skin grow united with the skin. Let blood and bone grow strong in thee, flesh grow together with the flesh.
Join thou together hair with hair, join thou together skin with skin. Let blood and bone grow strong in thee. Unite the broken part, O Plant.
Arise, advance, speed forth: the car hath goodly fellies, naves, and wheels. Stand up erect upon thy feet.
If he be torn and shattered, having fallen into a pit, or a cast stone have struck him, Let the skilled leech join limb with limb, as 'twere the portions of a car.

sections.label: A charm f o restore a sick man to health
sections.name: Hymn 13

verses.sa:
उत देवा अवहितं देवा उन्नयथा पुनः ।
उतागश्चक्रुषं देवा देवा जीवयथा पुनः॥
verses.tr: uta devā avahitaṃ devā unnayathā punaḥ utāgaścakruṣaṃ devā devā jīvayathā punaḥ
verses.en: Gods, raise again the man whom ye, O Gods, have humbled and brought low. Ye Gods, restore to life again, him, Gods! who hath committed sin.

verses.sa:
द्वाविमौ वातौ वात आ सिन्धोरा परावतः ।
दक्षं ते अन्य आवातु व्य१न्यो वातु यद् रपः॥
verses.tr: dvāvimau vātau vāta ā sindhorā parāvataḥ dakṣaṃ te anya āvātu vya1nyo vātu yad rapaḥ
verses.en: Here these two winds are blowing far as Sindhu from a distant land. May one breathe energy to thee, the other blow thy fault away.

verses.sa:
आ वात वाहि भेषजं वि वात वाहि यद्रपः ।
त्वं हि विश्वभेषज देवानां दूत ईयसे॥
verses.tr: ā vāta vāhi bheṣajaṃ vi vāta vāhi yadrapaḥ tvaṃ hi viśvabheṣaja devānāṃ dūta īyase
verses.en: Hither, O Wind, blow healing balm, blow every fault away, thou Wind! For thou who hast all medicine comest as envoy of the Gods.

verses.sa:
त्रायन्तामिमं देवास्त्रायन्तां मरुतां गणाः ।
त्रायन्तां विश्वा भूतानि यथायमरपा असत्॥
verses.tr: trāyantāmimaṃ devāstrāyantāṃ marutāṃ gaṇāḥ trāyantāṃ viśvā bhūtāni yathāyamarapā asat
verses.en: May the Gods keep and save this man, the Maruts' host deliver him. All things that be deliver him that he be freed from his offence.

verses.sa:
आ त्वागमं शंतातिभिरथो अरिष्टतातिभिः ।
दक्षं त उग्रमाभारिषं परा यक्ष्मं सुवामि ते॥
verses.tr: ā tvāgamaṃ śaṃtātibhiratho ariṣṭatātibhiḥ dakṣaṃ ta ugramābhāriṣaṃ parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te
verses.en: I am come nigh to thee with balms to give thee rest and keep thee safe. I bring thee mighty strength, I drive thy wasting malady away.

verses.sa:
अयं मे हस्तो भगवानयं मे भगवत्तरः ।
अयं मे विश्वभेषजोऽयं शिवाभिमर्शनः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ me hasto bhagavānayaṃ me bhagavattaraḥ ayaṃ me viśvabheṣajo'yaṃ śivābhimarśanaḥ
verses.en: Felicitous is this my hand, yet more felicitous is this. This hand contains all healing balms, and this makes whole with gentle touch.

verses.sa:
हस्ताभ्यां दशशाखाभ्यां जिह्वा वाचः पुरोगवी।
अनामयित्नुभ्यां हस्ताभ्यां ताभ्यां त्वाभि मृशामसि॥
verses.tr: hastābhyāṃ daśaśākhābhyāṃ jihvā vācaḥ purogavī anāmayitnubhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ tvābhi mṛśāmasi
verses.en: The tongue that leads the voice precedes. Then with our tenfold-branching hands, With these two healers of disease, we stroke thee with a soft caress.

sections.label: An accompaniment to a sacrifice of a he-goat
sections.name: Hymn 14

verses.sa:
अजो ह्य१ग्नेरजनिष्ट शोकात् सो अपश्यज्जनितारमग्रे ।
तेन देवा देवतामग्रा आयन् तेन रोहान् रुरुहुर्मेध्यासः॥
verses.tr: ajo hya1gnerajaniṣṭa śokāt so apaśyajjanitāramagre tena devā devatāmagrā āyan tena rohān ruruhurmedhyāsaḥ
verses.en: THe Goat was verily produced from Agni. Through sorrow he beheld, at first, his father. Through him at first the Gods attained to godhead, and, meet for sacrifices, were exalted.

verses.sa:
क्रमध्वमग्निना नाकमुख्यान् हस्तेषु बिभ्रतः ।
दिवस्पृष्ठं स्वऽर्गत्वा मिश्रा देवेभिराध्वम्॥
verses.tr: kramadhvamagninā nākamukhyān hasteṣu bibhrataḥ divaspṛṣṭhaṃ sva'rgatvā miśrā devebhirādhvam
verses.en: Bearing in hands seethed viands, go with Agni to the cope of heaven. Reaching the sky that touches heaven, mix with the company of Gods.

verses.sa:
पृष्ठात् पृथिव्या अहमन्तरिक्षमारुहमन्तरिक्षाद् दिवमारुहम्।
दिवो नाकस्य पृष्ठात् स्व१र्ज्योतिरगामहम्॥
verses.tr: pṛṣṭhāt pṛthivyā ahamantarikṣamāruhamantarikṣād divamāruham divo nākasya pṛṣṭhāt sva1rjyotiragāmaham
verses.en: From earth's high ridge to middle air I mounted, and from mid-air ascended up to heaven. From the high pitch of heaven's cope I came into the world of light.

verses.sa:
स्व१र्यन्तो नापेक्षन्त आ द्यां रोहन्ति रोदसी ।
यज्ञं ये विश्वतोधारं सुविद्वांसो वितेनिरे॥
verses.tr: sva1ryanto nāpekṣanta ā dyāṃ rohanti rodasī yajñaṃ ye viśvatodhāraṃ suvidvāṃso vitenire
verses.en: Mounting the sky they look not round; they rise to heaven through both the worlds, Sages who paid the sacrifice that pours its streams on every side.

verses.sa:
अग्ने प्रेहि प्रथमो देवतानां चक्षुर्देवानामुत मानुषानाम्।
इयक्षमाणा भृगुभिः सजोषाः स्वऽर्यन्तु यजमानाः स्वस्ति॥
verses.tr: agne prehi prathamo devatānāṃ cakṣurdevānāmuta mānuṣānām iyakṣamāṇā bhṛgubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ sva'ryantu yajamānāḥ svasti
verses.en: First among all the deities, come forward, thou who art eye of Gods and men, O Agni. Imploring, and accordant with the Bhrigus, to heaven in safety go the sacrificers!

verses.sa:
अजमनज्मि पयसा घृतेन दिव्यं सुपर्नं पयसं बृहन्तम्।
तेन गेष्म सुकृतस्य लोकं स्वऽरारोहन्तो अभि नाकमुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: ajamanajmi payasā ghṛtena divyaṃ suparnaṃ payasaṃ bṛhantam tena geṣma sukṛtasya lokaṃ sva'rārohanto abhi nākamuttamam
verses.en: With milk and butter I anoint the mighty, celestial Goat, strong-winged, and full of juices. ` Through him will we attain the world of virtue, ascending to the loftiest cope, to heaven.

verses.sa:
पञ्चौदनं पञ्चभिरङ्गुलिभिर्दर्व्योद्धर पञ्चधैतमोदनम्।
प्राच्यां दिशि शिरो अजस्य धेहि दक्षिणायां दिशि दक्षिणं धेहि पार्श्वम्॥
verses.tr: pañcaudanaṃ pañcabhiraṅgulibhirdarvyoddhara pañcadhaitamodanam prācyāṃ diśi śiro ajasya dhehi dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi dakṣiṇaṃ dhehi pārśvam
verses.en: Set the Goat's head toward the eastern region, and turn his right side to the southern quarter. His hinder part turn to the western quarter, and set his left side to the northern region.

verses.sa:
प्रतीच्यां दिशि भसदमस्य धेह्युत्तरस्यां दिश्युत्तरं धेहि पार्श्वम्।
ऊर्ध्वायां दिश्य१जस्यानूकं धेहि दिशि ध्रुवायां धेहि पाजस्यऽमन्तरिक्षे मध्यतो मध्यमस्य॥
verses.tr: pratīcyāṃ diśi bhasadamasya dhehyuttarasyāṃ diśyuttaraṃ dhehi pārśvam ūrdhvāyāṃ diśya1jasyānūkaṃ dhehi diśi dhruvāyāṃ dhehi pājasya'mantarikṣe madhyato madhyamasya
verses.en: Set the Goat's backbone upmost in the zenith, and lay his belly downward in the nadir; set his mid-portion in mid-air between them.

verses.sa:
शृतमजं शृतया प्रोर्णुहि त्वचा सर्वैरङ्गैः संभृतं विश्वरूपम्।
स उत् तिष्ठेतो अभि नाकमुत्तमं पद्भिश्चतुर्भिः प्रति तिष्ठ दिक्षु॥
verses.tr: śṛtamajaṃ śṛtayā prorṇuhi tvacā sarvairaṅgaiḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ viśvarūpam sa ut tiṣṭheto abhi nākamuttamaṃ padbhiścaturbhiḥ prati tiṣṭha dikṣu
verses.en: O'er the dressed Goat lay a dressed skin to robe him prepared, in perfect form, with all his members. Rise upward to the loftiest vault of heaven: with thy four feet stand firmly in the regions.

sections.label: A charm to hasten the coming of the Gains
sections.name: Hymn 15

verses.sa:
समुत्पतन्तु प्रदिशो नभस्वतीः समभ्राणि वातजूतानि यन्तु ।
महऋषभस्य नदतो नभस्वतो वाश्रा आपः पृथिवीं तर्पयन्तु॥
verses.tr: samutpatantu pradiśo nabhasvatīḥ samabhrāṇi vātajūtāni yantu mahaṛṣabhasya nadato nabhasvato vāśrā āpaḥ pṛthivīṃ tarpayantu
verses.en: Let all the misty regions fly together, let all the rain-clouds, sped by wind, assemble. Let waters satisfy the earth, the voices of the great mist-enveloped Bull who roareth.

verses.sa:
समीक्षयन्तु तविषाः सुदानवो ऽपां रसा ओषधीभिः सचन्ताम्।
वर्षस्य सर्गा महयन्तु भूमिं पृथग् जायन्तामोषधयो विश्वरूपाः॥
verses.tr: samīkṣayantu taviṣāḥ sudānavo 'pāṃ rasā oṣadhībhiḥ sacantām varṣasya sargā mahayantu bhūmiṃ pṛthag jāyantāmoṣadhayo viśvarūpāḥ
verses.en: Let them show forth, the strong, the bounteous Maruts: let plants and shrubs be hung with drops of moisture. Let floods of rain refresh the ground with gladness, and herbs spring various with each form and colour.

verses.sa:
समीक्षयस्व गायतो नभांस्यपां वेगासः पृथगुद् विजन्ताम्।
वर्षस्य सर्गा महयन्तु भूमिं पृथग् जायन्तां वीरुधो विश्वरूपाः॥
verses.tr: samīkṣayasva gāyato nabhāṃsyapāṃ vegāsaḥ pṛthagud vijantām varṣasya sargā mahayantu bhūmiṃ pṛthag jāyantāṃ vīrudho viśvarūpāḥ
verses.en: Cause us who sing to see the gathering vapours: out burst in many a place the rush of waters! Let floods of rain refresh the ground with gladness; and herbs spring various with each form and colour.

verses.sa:
गणास्त्वोप गायन्तु मारुताः पर्जन्य घोषिणः पृथक्।
सर्गा वर्षस्य वर्षतो वर्षन्तु पृथिवीमनु॥
verses.tr: gaṇāstvopa gāyantu mārutāḥ parjanya ghoṣiṇaḥ pṛthak sargā varṣasya varṣato varṣantu pṛthivīmanu
verses.en: Apart, Parjanya let the troops of Maruts, roaring, swell the song. Let pouring. torrents of the rain that. raineth, rain upon the earth.

verses.sa:
उदीरयत मरुतः समुद्रतस्त्वेषो अर्को नभ उत् पातयाथ ।
महऋषभस्य नदतो नभस्वतो वाश्रा आपः पृथिवीं तर्पयन्तु॥
verses.tr: udīrayata marutaḥ samudratastveṣo arko nabha ut pātayātha mahaṛṣabhasya nadato nabhasvato vāśrā āpaḥ pṛthivīṃ tarpayantu
verses.en: Up from the sea lift your dread might, ye Maruts.- as light and splendour, send the vapour upward! Let waters satisfy the earth, the voices of. the great. mist-enveloped Bull who roareth.

verses.sa:
अभि क्रन्द स्तनयार्दयोदधिं भूमिं पर्जन्य पयसा समङ्धि ।
त्वया सृष्टं बहुलमैतु वर्षमाशारैषी कृशगुरेत्वस्तम्॥
verses.tr: abhi kranda stanayārdayodadhiṃ bhūmiṃ parjanya payasā samaṅdhi tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ bahulamaitu varṣamāśāraiṣī kṛśaguretvastam
verses.en: Roar, thunder, set the sea in agitation, bedew the ground with thy sweet rain, Parjanya. Send plenteous showers on him. who seeketh shelter, and let the owner of lean. kine go homeward.

verses.sa:
सं वोऽवन्तु सुदानव उत्सा अजगरा उत।
मरुद्भिः प्रच्युता मेघा वर्षन्तु पृथिवीमनु॥
verses.tr: saṃ vo'vantu sudānava utsā ajagarā uta marudbhiḥ pracyutā meghā varṣantu pṛthivīmanu
verses.en: Let the boon Maruts, let the springs and coiling serpents tend you well. Urged by the Maruts let. the clouds pour down their rain upon the earth:

verses.sa:
आशामाशां वि द्योततां वाता वान्तु दिशोदिशः ।
मरुद्भिः प्रच्युता मेघाः सं यन्तु पृथिवीमनु॥
verses.tr: āśāmāśāṃ vi dyotatāṃ vātā vāntu diśodiśaḥ marudbhiḥ pracyutā meghāḥ saṃ yantu pṛthivīmanu
verses.en: Let lightning flash on every side: from all the regions blow the winds! Urged by the Maruts let the clouds pour down their rain upon the earth.

verses.sa:
आपो विद्युदभ्रं वर्षं सं वोऽवन्तु सुदानव उत्सा अजगरा उत।
मरुद्भिः प्रच्युता मेघाः प्रावन्तु पृथिवीमनु॥
verses.tr: āpo vidyudabhraṃ varṣaṃ saṃ vo'vantu sudānava utsā ajagarā uta marudbhiḥ pracyutā meghāḥ prāvantu pṛthivīmanu
verses.en: May waters, lightning, cloud, and rain, boon springs and serpents tend you well. Urged by the Maruts let the clouds pour down their rain upon. the earth.

verses.sa:
अपामग्निस्तनूभिः संविदानो य ओषधीनामधिपा बभूव ।
स नो वर्षं वनुतां जातवेदाः प्राणं प्रजाभ्यो अमृतं दिवस्परि॥
verses.tr: apāmagnistanūbhiḥ saṃvidāno ya oṣadhīnāmadhipā babhūva sa no varṣaṃ vanutāṃ jātavedāḥ prāṇaṃ prajābhyo amṛtaṃ divaspari
verses.en: May he who hath become the plants' high regent, suiting our bodies, Agni of the Waters, May Jatavedas send us rain from heaven, Amrit and vital breath to earthly creatures.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिः सलिलादा समुद्रादाप ईरयन्नुदधिमर्दयाति ।
प्र प्यायतां वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतोऽर्वाङेतेन स्तनयित्नुनेहि॥
verses.tr: prajāpatiḥ salilādā samudrādāpa īrayannudadhimardayāti pra pyāyatāṃ vṛṣṇo aśvasya reto'rvāṅetena stanayitnunehi
verses.en: Sending up waters from the flood and ocean Prajapati move the sea to agitation! Forth flow the moisture of the vigorous stallion! With this thy roar of thunder come thou hither,

verses.sa:
अपो निषिञ्चन्नसुरः पिता नः श्वसन्तु गर्गरा अपां वरुणाव नीचीरपः सृज ।
वदन्तु पृश्निबाहवो मण्डूका इरिणानु॥
verses.tr: apo niṣiñcannasuraḥ pitā naḥ śvasantu gargarā apāṃ varuṇāva nīcīrapaḥ sṛja vadantu pṛśnibāhavo maṇḍūkā iriṇānu
verses.en: Our Father, Lord divine pouring the torrents. Let the streams breathe, O Varuna, of the waters. Pour the floods down: along the brooks and channels let frogs with speckled arms send out their voices.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरं शशयाना ब्राह्मणा व्रतचारिणः ।
वाचं पर्जन्यजिन्वितां प्र मण्डूका अवादिषुः॥
verses.tr: saṃvatsaraṃ śaśayānā brāhmaṇā vratacāriṇaḥ vācaṃ parjanyajinvitāṃ pra maṇḍūkā avādiṣuḥ
verses.en: They who lay quiet for a year, the Brahmans who fulfil their vows, The frogs, have lifted up their voice, the voice Parjanya hath inspired.

verses.sa:
उपप्रवद मण्डूकि वर्षमा वद तादुरि ।
मध्ये ह्रदस्य प्लवस्व विगृह्य चतुरः पदः॥
verses.tr: upapravada maṇḍūki varṣamā vada tāduri madhye hradasya plavasva vigṛhya caturaḥ padaḥ
verses.en: Speak forth a welcome, female frog! Do thou, O frog, accost the rain. Stretch thy four feet apart, and swim, swim in the middle of the lake.

verses.sa:
खण्वखा३इ खैमखा३इ मध्ये तदुरि ।
वर्षं वनुध्वं पितरो मरुतां मन इछत॥
verses.tr: khaṇvakhā3i khaimakhā3i madhye taduri varṣaṃ vanudhvaṃ pitaro marutāṃ mana ichata
verses.en: Khanvakha, ho! I Khaimakha, ho! Thou in the middle, Taduri! Fathers, enjoy the rain from one who strives to win the Maruts' heart.

verses.sa:
महान्तं कोशमुदचाभि षिञ्च सविद्युतं भवतु वातु वातः ।
तन्वतां यज्ञं बहुधा विसृष्टा आनन्दिनीरोषधयो भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: mahāntaṃ kośamudacābhi ṣiñca savidyutaṃ bhavatu vātu vātaḥ tanvatāṃ yajñaṃ bahudhā visṛṣṭā ānandinīroṣadhayo bhavantu
verses.en: Lift up the mighty cask and pour down water: let the wind blow, and lightnings flash around us. Let sacrifice be paid, and, widely scattered, let herbs and plants be full of joy and gladness.

sections.label: On the omnipresence and omniscience of aruna
sections.name: Hymn 16

verses.sa:
बृहन्नेषामधिष्ठाता अन्तिकादिव पश्यति ।
य स्तायन्मन्यते चरन्त्सर्वं देवा इदं विदुः॥
verses.tr: bṛhanneṣāmadhiṣṭhātā antikādiva paśyati ya stāyanmanyate carantsarvaṃ devā idaṃ viduḥ
verses.en: The mighty Ruler of these worlds beholds as though from close at hand The man who thinks he acts by stealth: all this the Gods perceive and know.

verses.sa:
यस्तिष्ठति चरति यश्च वञ्चति यो निलायं चरति यः प्रतङ्कम्।
द्वौ संनिषद्य यन्मन्त्रयेते राजा तद् वेद वरुणस्तृतीयः॥
verses.tr: yastiṣṭhati carati yaśca vañcati yo nilāyaṃ carati yaḥ prataṅkam dvau saṃniṣadya yanmantrayete rājā tad veda varuṇastṛtīyaḥ
verses.en: If a man stands or walks or moves in secret, goes to his lying-down or his uprising, What two men whisper as they sit together, King Varuna knows: he as the third is present.

verses.sa:
उतेयं भूमिर्वरुणस्य राज्ञ उतासौ द्यौर्बृहती दूरेअन्ता ।
उतो समुद्रौ वरुणस्य कुक्षी उतास्मिन्नल्प उदके निलीनः॥
verses.tr: uteyaṃ bhūmirvaruṇasya rājña utāsau dyaurbṛhatī dūreantā uto samudrau varuṇasya kukṣī utāsminnalpa udake nilīnaḥ
verses.en: This earth, too, is King Varuna's possession, and the high heaven whose ends are far asunder. The loins of Varuna are both the oceans, and this small drop of water, too, contains him.

verses.sa:
उत यो द्यामतिसर्पात् परस्तान्न स मुच्यातै वरुणस्य राज्ञः ।
दिव स्पशः प्र चरन्तीदमस्य सहस्राक्षा अति पश्यन्ति भूमिम्॥
verses.tr: uta yo dyāmatisarpāt parastānna sa mucyātai varuṇasya rājñaḥ diva spaśaḥ pra carantīdamasya sahasrākṣā ati paśyanti bhūmim
verses.en: If one should flee afar beyond the heaven, King Varuna would still be round about him. Proceeding hither from the sky his envoys look, thousand-eyed, over the earth beneath them.

verses.sa:
सर्वं तद् राजा वरुणो वि चष्टे यदन्तरा रोदसी यत् परस्तात्।
संख्याता अस्य निमिषो जनानामक्षानिव श्वघ्नी नि मिनोति तानि॥
verses.tr: sarvaṃ tad rājā varuṇo vi caṣṭe yadantarā rodasī yat parastāt saṃkhyātā asya nimiṣo janānāmakṣāniva śvaghnī ni minoti tāni
verses.en: All this the royal Varuna beholdeth, all between heaven and earth and all beyond. them. The twinklings of men's eyelids hath he counted. As one who plays throws dice he settles all things.

verses.sa:
ये ते पाशा वरुण सप्तसप्त त्रेधा तिष्ठन्ति विषिता रुशन्तः ।
छिनन्तु सर्वे अनृतं वदन्तं यः सत्यवाद्यति तं सृजन्तु॥
verses.tr: ye te pāśā varuṇa saptasapta tredhā tiṣṭhanti viṣitā ruśantaḥ chinantu sarve anṛtaṃ vadantaṃ yaḥ satyavādyati taṃ sṛjantu
verses.en: Those fatal snares of thine which stand extended, threefold, O Varuna, seven by seven, May they all catch the man who tells a falsehood, and pass unharmed the man whose words are truthful.

verses.sa:
शतेन पाशैरभि धेहि वरुणैनं मा ते मोच्यनृतवाङ् नृचक्षः ।
आस्तां जाल्म उदरं श्रंसयित्वा कोश इवाबन्धः परिकृत्यमानः॥
verses.tr: śatena pāśairabhi dhehi varuṇainaṃ mā te mocyanṛtavāṅ nṛcakṣaḥ āstāṃ jālma udaraṃ śraṃsayitvā kośa ivābandhaḥ parikṛtyamānaḥ
verses.en: Varuna, snare him with a hundred nooses! Man's. watcher! let not him who lies escape thee. There let the villain sit with hanging belly and bandaged like a cask whose hoops are broken.

verses.sa:
यः समाम्यो३वरुणो यो व्याम्यो३यः संदेश्यो३वरुणो यो विदेश्यः ।
यो दैवो वरुणो यश्च मानुषः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ samāmyo3varuṇo yo vyāmyo3yaḥ saṃdeśyo3varuṇo yo videśyaḥ yo daivo varuṇo yaśca mānuṣaḥ
verses.en: Varuna sends, and drives away, diseases: Varuna is both native and a stranger, Varuna is celestial and is human.

verses.sa:
तैस्त्वा सर्वैरभि ष्यामि पाशैरसावामुष्यायणामुष्याः पुत्र ।
तानु ते सर्वाननुसंदिशामि॥
verses.tr: taistvā sarvairabhi ṣyāmi pāśairasāvāmuṣyāyaṇāmuṣyāḥ putra tānu te sarvānanusaṃdiśāmi
verses.en: I bind and hold thee fast with all these nooses, thou son of such a man and such a mother. All these do I assign thee as thy portion.

sections.label: A charm to secure freedom from various evils
sections.name: Hymn 17

verses.sa:
ईशाणां त्वा भेषजानामुज्जेष आ रभामहे ।
चक्रे सहस्रवीर्यं सर्वस्मा ओषधे त्वा॥
verses.tr: īśāṇāṃ tvā bheṣajānāmujjeṣa ā rabhāmahe cakre sahasravīryaṃ sarvasmā oṣadhe tvā
verses.en: We seize and hold thee, Conquering One! the queen of medicines that heal. O Plant, I have endowed thee with a hundred powers for every man.

verses.sa:
सत्यजितं शपथयावनीं सहमानां पुनःसराम्।
सर्वाः समह्व्योषधीरितो नः पारयादिति॥
verses.tr: satyajitaṃ śapathayāvanīṃ sahamānāṃ punaḥsarām sarvāḥ samahvyoṣadhīrito naḥ pārayāditi
verses.en: Still conquering, banishing the curse, mighty, with thy reverted bloom, Thee and all Plants have I invoked: Hence let it save us! was my prayer.

verses.sa:
या शशाप शपनेन याघं मूरमादधे।
या रसस्य हरणाय जातमारेभे तोकमत्तु सा॥
verses.tr: yā śaśāpa śapanena yāghaṃ mūramādadhe yā rasasya haraṇāya jātamārebhe tokamattu sā
verses.en: She who hath cursed us with a curse, or hath conceived a murderous sin, Or seized our son to take his blood, may she devour the child she bare.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुरामे पात्रे यां चक्रुर्नीललोहिते।
आमे मांसे कृत्यां यां चक्रुस्तया कृत्याकृतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te cakrurāme pātre yāṃ cakrurnīlalohite āme māṃse kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakrustayā kṛtyākṛto jahi
verses.en: What magic they have wrought for thee in dish unbaked or burnt dark-red, What they have wrought in flesh undressed,—conquer the sorcerers therewith.

verses.sa:
दौष्वप्न्यं दौर्जीवित्यं रक्षो अभ्वऽमराय्यः ।
दुर्णाम्नीः सर्वा दुर्वाचस्ता अस्मन्नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: dauṣvapnyaṃ daurjīvityaṃ rakṣo abhva'marāyyaḥ durṇāmnīḥ sarvā durvācastā asmannāśayāmasi
verses.en: Ill dream and wretchedness of life, Rakshasa, monster, stingy hags, All the she-fiends of evil name and voice, we drive away from us.

verses.sa:
क्षुधामारं तृष्णामारमगोतामनपत्यताम्।
अपामार्ग त्वया वयं सर्वं तदप मृज्महे॥
verses.tr: kṣudhāmāraṃ tṛṣṇāmāramagotāmanapatyatām apāmārga tvayā vayaṃ sarvaṃ tadapa mṛjmahe
verses.en: Death caused by famine, caused by thirst, failure of children, loss of kine, With thee, O Apamarga, all this ill we cleanse. and wipe away.

verses.sa:
तृष्णामारं क्षुधामारमथो अक्षपराजयम्।
अपामार्ग त्वया वयं सर्वं तदप मृज्महे॥
verses.tr: tṛṣṇāmāraṃ kṣudhāmāramatho akṣaparājayam apāmārga tvayā vayaṃ sarvaṃ tadapa mṛjmahe
verses.en: Death caused by thirst, death caused by stress of hunger, loss at play with dice, All this, O Apamarga, with thine aid we cleanse and wipe away.

verses.sa:
अपामार्ग ओषधीनां सर्वासामेक इद् वशी।
तेन ते मृज्म आस्थितमथ त्वमगदश्चर॥
verses.tr: apāmārga oṣadhīnāṃ sarvāsāmeka id vaśī tena te mṛjma āsthitamatha tvamagadaścara
verses.en: The Apamarga is alone the sovran of all Plants that grow. With this we wipe away whate'er hath fallen on thee: goin health!

sections.label: A counter-charm against the incantations of enemies
sections.name: Hymn 18

verses.sa:
समं ज्योतिः सूर्येणाह्ना रात्री समावती ।
कृणोमि सत्यमूतयेऽरसाः सन्तु कृत्वरीः॥
verses.tr: samaṃ jyotiḥ sūryeṇāhnā rātrī samāvatī kṛṇomi satyamūtaye'rasāḥ santu kṛtvarīḥ
verses.en: The moonlight equalleth the sun, night is the rival of the day. I make effectual power my help: let magic arts be impotent.

verses.sa:
यो देवाः कृत्यां कृत्वा हरादविदुषो गृहम्।
वत्सो धारुरिव मातरं तं प्रत्यगुप पद्यताम्॥
verses.tr: yo devāḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtvā harādaviduṣo gṛham vatso dhāruriva mātaraṃ taṃ pratyagupa padyatām
verses.en: Gods! if one make and bring a spell on some man's. house who knows it not, Close as the calf that sucks the cow may it revert and cling to him.

verses.sa:
अमा कृत्वा पाप्मानं यस्तेनान्यं जिघांसति ।
अश्मानस्तस्यां दग्धायां बहुलाः फट् करिक्रति॥
verses.tr: amā kṛtvā pāpmānaṃ yastenānyaṃ jighāṃsati aśmānastasyāṃ dagdhāyāṃ bahulāḥ phaṭ karikrati
verses.en: When one puts poison in a dish of unbaked clay to kill a man, It cracks when set upon the fire with the sharp sound of many stones.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधामन् विशिखान् विग्रीवां छायया त्वम्।
प्रति स्म चक्रुषे कृत्यां प्रियां प्रियावते हर॥
verses.tr: sahasradhāman viśikhān vigrīvāṃ chāyayā tvam prati sma cakruṣe kṛtyāṃ priyāṃ priyāvate hara
verses.en: Endowed with thousand powers! adjure the bald and those with necks awry. Back to its author turn the spell like a dear damsel to her friend!

verses.sa:
अनयाहमोषध्या सर्वाः कृत्या अदूदुषम्।
यां क्षेत्रे चक्रुर्यां गोषु यां वा ते पुरुषेषु॥
verses.tr: anayāhamoṣadhyā sarvāḥ kṛtyā adūduṣam yāṃ kṣetre cakruryāṃ goṣu yāṃ vā te puruṣeṣu
verses.en: I with this Plant have ruined all malignant powers of witchery, The spell which they have laid upon thy field, thy cattle, or thy men.

verses.sa:
यश्चकार न शशाक कर्तुं शश्रे पादमङ्गुरिम्।
चकार भद्रमस्मभ्यमात्मने तपनं तु सः॥
verses.tr: yaścakāra na śaśāka kartuṃ śaśre pādamaṅgurim cakāra bhadramasmabhyamātmane tapanaṃ tu saḥ
verses.en: No power had he who wrought the spell: he hurt his foot, he broke his toe. His act hath brought us happiness and pain and sorrow to himself.

verses.sa:
अपामार्गोऽप मार्ष्टु क्षेत्रियं शपथश्च यः ।
अपाह यातुधानीरप सर्वा अराय्यः॥
verses.tr: apāmārgo'pa mārṣṭu kṣetriyaṃ śapathaśca yaḥ apāha yātudhānīrapa sarvā arāyyaḥ
verses.en: Let Apamarga sweep away chronic disease and every curse, Sweep sorceresses clean away, and all malignant stingy hags.

verses.sa:
अपमृज्य यातुधानानप सर्वा अराय्यः ।
अपामार्ग त्वया वयं सर्वं तदप मृज्महे॥
verses.tr: apamṛjya yātudhānānapa sarvā arāyyaḥ apāmārga tvayā vayaṃ sarvaṃ tadapa mṛjmahe
verses.en: Sweep thou away the sorcerers, all stingy fiendish hags away. All this, O Apamarga, with thine aid we wipe away from us.

sections.label: A counter-charm and charm to secure general protection
sections.name: Hymn 19

verses.sa:
उतो अस्यबन्धुकृदुतो असि नु जामिकृत्।
उतो कृत्याकृतः प्रजां नडमिवा छिन्धि वार्षिकम्॥
verses.tr: uto asyabandhukṛduto asi nu jāmikṛt uto kṛtyākṛtaḥ prajāṃ naḍamivā chindhi vārṣikam
verses.en: Thou breakest ties of kith and kin, thou causest, too, relationship: So bruise the sorcerer's offspring, like a reed that groweth in the Rains.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणेन पर्युक्तासि कण्वेन नार्षदेन ।
सेनेवैषि त्विषीमती न तत्र भयमस्ति यत्र प्राप्नोष्योषधे॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇena paryuktāsi kaṇvena nārṣadena senevaiṣi tviṣīmatī na tatra bhayamasti yatra prāpnoṣyoṣadhe
verses.en: Thou hast been blessed with blessing by the Brahman, Kanva Narada. Thou fliest like a flashing dart: there is no fear or danger, Plant! within the limit of thy range.

verses.sa:
अग्रमेष्योषधीनां ज्योतिषेवाभिदीपयन्।
उत त्रातासि पाकस्याथो हन्तासि रक्षसः॥
verses.tr: agrameṣyoṣadhīnāṃ jyotiṣevābhidīpayan uta trātāsi pākasyātho hantāsi rakṣasaḥ
verses.en: Illumining, as 'twere, with light, thou movest at the head of plants. The saviour of the simple man art thou, and slayer of the fiends.

verses.sa:
यददो देवा असुरांस्त्वयाग्रे निरकुर्वत ।
ततस्त्वमध्योषधेऽपामार्गो अजायथाः॥
verses.tr: yadado devā asurāṃstvayāgre nirakurvata tatastvamadhyoṣadhe'pāmārgo ajāyathāḥ
verses.en: As once when time began the Gods with thee expelled the A sura? Even thence, O Plant, wast thou produced as one who wipes and sweeps away.

verses.sa:
विभिन्दती शतशाखा विभिन्दन् नाम ते पिता।
प्रत्यग् वि भिन्धि त्वं तं यो अस्माँ अभिदासति॥
verses.tr: vibhindatī śataśākhā vibhindan nāma te pitā pratyag vi bhindhi tvaṃ taṃ yo asmāṃ abhidāsati
verses.en: Thy father's name was Cleaver. Thou with thousand branches cleavest all. Do thou, turned backward, cleave and rend the man who treateth us as foes.

verses.sa:
असद् भूम्याः समभवत् तद् यामेति महद् व्यचः ।
तद् वै ततो विधूपायत् प्रत्यक् कर्तारमृच्छतु॥
verses.tr: asad bhūmyāḥ samabhavat tad yāmeti mahad vyacaḥ tad vai tato vidhūpāyat pratyak kartāramṛcchatu
verses.en: The evil sprang from earth; it mounts to heaven and spreads to vast extent. Reverted, shaking him with might, thence on its maker let it fall.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यङ् हि संबभूविथ प्रतीचीनफलस्त्वम्।
सर्वान् मच्छपथाँ अधि वरीयो यावया वधम्॥
verses.tr: pratyaṅ hi saṃbabhūvitha pratīcīnaphalastvam sarvān macchapathāṃ adhi varīyo yāvayā vadham
verses.en: For thou hast grown reverted, and turned backward also is thy fruit. Remove all curses far from me, keep most remote the stroke of death.

verses.sa:
शतेन मा परि पाहि सहस्रेणाभि रक्ष मा ।
इन्द्रस्ते वीरुधां पत उग्र ओज्मानमा दधत्॥
verses.tr: śatena mā pari pāhi sahasreṇābhi rakṣa mā indraste vīrudhāṃ pata ugra ojmānamā dadhat
verses.en: Preserve me with a hundred, yea, protect me with a thousand aids. May mighty Indra, Lord of Plants! give store of strength and power to thee.

sections.label: A charm for the acquisition of superhuman powers of sight
sections.name: Hymn 20

verses.sa:
आ पश्यति प्रति पश्यति परा पश्यति पश्यति ।
दिवमन्तरिक्षमाद् भूमिं सर्वं तद् देवि पश्यति॥
verses.tr: ā paśyati prati paśyati parā paśyati paśyati divamantarikṣamād bhūmiṃ sarvaṃ tad devi paśyati
verses.en: It sees in front, it sees behind, it sees afar away, it sees The sky, the firmament, and earth: all this, O Goddess, it beholds.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो दिवस्तिस्रः पृथिवीः षट् चेमाः प्रदिशः पृथक्।
त्वयाहं सर्वा भूतानि पश्यानि देव्योषधे॥
verses.tr: tisro divastisraḥ pṛthivīḥ ṣaṭ cemāḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthak tvayāhaṃ sarvā bhūtāni paśyāni devyoṣadhe
verses.en: Through thee, O godlike Plant, may I behold all creatures that exist, Three several heavens, three several earths, and these six regions one by one.

verses.sa:
दिव्यस्य सुपर्णस्य तस्य हासि कनीनिका ।
सा भूमिमा रुरोहिथ वह्यं श्रान्ता वधूरिव॥
verses.tr: divyasya suparṇasya tasya hāsi kanīnikā sā bhūmimā rurohitha vahyaṃ śrāntā vadhūriva
verses.en: The pupil, verily, art thou of that celestial Eagle's eye. On earth hast thou alighted as a weary woman seeks her couch.

verses.sa:
तां मे सहस्राक्षो देवो दक्षिणे हस्त आ दधत्।
तयाहं सर्वं पश्यामि यश्च शूद्र उतार्यः॥
verses.tr: tāṃ me sahasrākṣo devo dakṣiṇe hasta ā dadhat tayāhaṃ sarvaṃ paśyāmi yaśca śūdra utāryaḥ
verses.en: The God who hath a thousand eyes give me this Plant in my right hand! I look on every one therewith, each Sudra and each Aryan man.

verses.sa:
आविष्कृणुष्व रूपाणि मात्मानमप गूहथाः ।
अथो सहस्रचक्षो त्वं प्रति पश्याः किमीदिनः॥
verses.tr: āviṣkṛṇuṣva rūpāṇi mātmānamapa gūhathāḥ atho sahasracakṣo tvaṃ prati paśyāḥ kimīdinaḥ
verses.en: Make manifest the forms of things; hide not their essences from sight. And, thou who hast a thousand eyes, look the Kimidins in the face.

verses.sa:
दर्शय मा यातुधानान् दर्शय यातुधान्यः ।
पिशाचान्त्सर्वान् दर्शयेति त्वा रभ ओषधे॥
verses.tr: darśaya mā yātudhānān darśaya yātudhānyaḥ piśācāntsarvān darśayeti tvā rabha oṣadhe
verses.en: Make me see Yatudhanas, make thou Yatudhanis visible. Make me see all Pisachas. With this prayer, O Plant, I hold thee fast.

verses.sa:
कश्यपस्य चक्षुरसि शुन्याश्च चतुरक्ष्याः ।
वीध्रे सूर्यमिव सर्पन्तं मा पिशाचं तिरस्करः॥
verses.tr: kaśyapasya cakṣurasi śunyāśca caturakṣyāḥ vīdhre sūryamiva sarpantaṃ mā piśācaṃ tiraskaraḥ
verses.en: Thou art the sight of Kasyapa and of the hound who hath four eyes. Make the Pisacha manifest as Surya when he rides at noon.

verses.sa:
उदग्रभं परिपाणाद् यातुधानं किमीदिनम्।
तेनाहं सर्वं पश्याम्युत शूद्रमुतार्यम्॥
verses.tr: udagrabhaṃ paripāṇād yātudhānaṃ kimīdinam tenāhaṃ sarvaṃ paśyāmyuta śūdramutāryam
verses.en: Kimidin, Yatudhana from their hiding-places have I dragged. I look on every one with this, Sudra and Aryan man alike.

verses.sa:
यो अन्तरिक्षेण पतति दिवं यश्चातिसर्पति ।
भूमिं यो मन्यते नाथं तं पिशाचं प्र दर्शय॥
verses.tr: yo antarikṣeṇa patati divaṃ yaścātisarpati bhūmiṃ yo manyate nāthaṃ taṃ piśācaṃ pra darśaya
verses.en: Make that Pisacha visible, the fiend who flies in middle air, The fiend who glides across the sky, and him who deems the earth his help.

sections.label: Glorification and benediction of Cows
sections.name: Hymn 21

verses.sa:
आ गावो अग्मन्नुत भद्रमक्रन्त्सीदन्तु गोष्ठे रणयन्त्वस्मे।
प्रजावतीः पुरुरूपा इह स्युरिन्द्राय पूर्वीरुषसो दुहानाः॥
verses.tr: ā gāvo agmannuta bhadramakrantsīdantu goṣṭhe raṇayantvasme prajāvatīḥ pururūpā iha syurindrāya pūrvīruṣaso duhānāḥ
verses.en: The kine have come and brought good fortune: let them rest in the cow-pen and be happy near us. Here let them stay prolific, many-coloured, and: yield through many morns their milk for Indra.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो यज्वने गृणते च शिक्षत उपेद् ददाति न स्वं मुषायति ।
भूयोभूयो रयिमिदस्य वर्धयन्नभिन्ने खिल्ये नि दधाति देवयुम्॥
verses.tr: indro yajvane gṛṇate ca śikṣata uped dadāti na svaṃ muṣāyati bhūyobhūyo rayimidasya vardhayannabhinne khilye ni dadhāti devayum
verses.en: Indra aids him who offers sacrifice and praise: he takes not what is his, and gives him more thereto. Increasing ever more and ever more his wealth, he makes the pious dwell within unbroken bounds.

verses.sa:
न ता नशन्ति न दभाति तस्करो नासामामित्रो व्यथिरा दधर्षति ।
देवांश्च याभिर्यजते ददाति च ज्योगित् ताभिः सचते गोपतिः सह॥
verses.tr: na tā naśanti na dabhāti taskaro nāsāmāmitro vyathirā dadharṣati devāṃśca yābhiryajate dadāti ca jyogit tābhiḥ sacate gopatiḥ saha
verses.en: These are ne'er lost, no robber ever injures them: no evil-minded foe attempts to harass them. The master of the kine lives a long life with these, the Cows whereby he pours his gifts and serves the Gods. assail them. ll

verses.sa:
न ता अर्वा रेणुककाटोऽश्नुते न संस्कृतत्रमुप यन्ति ता अभि।
उरुगायमभयं तस्य ता अनु गावो मर्तस्य वि चरन्ति यज्वनः॥
verses.tr: na tā arvā reṇukakāṭo'śnute na saṃskṛtatramupa yanti tā abhi urugāyamabhayaṃ tasya tā anu gāvo martasya vi caranti yajvanaḥ
verses.en: The charger with his dusty brow o'ertakes them not, and never to the shambles do they take their way. These Cows, the cattle of the pious worshipper, roam over wide-spread pasture where no danger is.

verses.sa:
गावो भगो गाव इन्द्रो म इच्छाद् गावः सोमस्य प्रथमस्य भक्षः ।
इमा या गावः स जनास इन्द्र इच्छामि हृदा मनसा चिदिन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: gāvo bhago gāva indro ma icchād gāvaḥ somasya prathamasya bhakṣaḥ imā yā gāvaḥ sa janāsa indra icchāmi hṛdā manasā cidindram
verses.en: 'To me the Cows seem Bhaga, they seem Indra, they seem a portion of the first-poured Soma. These present Cows, they, O ye men, are Indra. I long for Indra with my heart and spirit.

verses.sa:
यूयं गावो मेदयथ कृशं चिदश्रीरं चित् कृणुथा सुप्रतीकम्।
भद्रं गृहं कृणुथ भद्रवाचो बृहद् वो वय उच्यते सभासु॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ gāvo medayatha kṛśaṃ cidaśrīraṃ cit kṛṇuthā supratīkam bhadraṃ gṛhaṃ kṛṇutha bhadravāco bṛhad vo vaya ucyate sabhāsu
verses.en: O Cows, ye fatten e'en the worn and wasted, and make the unlovely beautiful to look on. Prosper my home, ye with auspicious voices! Your power is magnified in our assemblies.

verses.sa:
प्रजावतीः सूयवसे रुशन्तीः शुद्धा अपः सुप्रपाणे पिबन्तीः ।
मा व स्तेन ईशत माघशंसः परि वो रुद्रस्य हेतिर्वृणक्तु॥
verses.tr: prajāvatīḥ sūyavase ruśantīḥ śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ mā va stena īśata māghaśaṃsaḥ pari vo rudrasya hetirvṛṇaktu
verses.en: In goodly pasturage, bright-hued, prolific, drinking pure water at fair drinking-places, Never be thief or sinful man your master, and may the dart of Rudra still avoid you!

sections.label: A benediction on a newly consecrated King
sections.name: Hymn 22

verses.sa:
इममिन्द्र वर्धय क्षत्रियं म इमं विशामेक वृषं कृणु त्वम्।
निरमित्रानक्ष्णुह्यस्य सर्वांस्तान् रन्धयास्मा अहमुत्तरेषु॥
verses.tr: imamindra vardhaya kṣatriyaṃ ma imaṃ viśāmeka vṛṣaṃ kṛṇu tvam niramitrānakṣṇuhyasya sarvāṃstān randhayāsmā ahamuttareṣu
verses.en: Exalt and strengthen this my Prince, O Indra. Make him sole lord and leader of the people. Scatter his foes, deliver all his rivals into his hand in struggles for precedence.

verses.sa:
एमं भज ग्रामे अश्वेषु गोषु निष्टं भज यो अमित्रो अस्य।
वर्ष्म क्षत्राणामयमस्तु राजेन्द्र शत्रुं रन्धय सर्वमस्मै॥
verses.tr: emaṃ bhaja grāme aśveṣu goṣu niṣṭaṃ bhaja yo amitro asya varṣma kṣatrāṇāmayamastu rājendra śatruṃ randhaya sarvamasmai
verses.en: Give him a share in village, kine, and horses, and leave his enemy without a portion. Let him as King be head and chief of Princes. Give up to him, O Indra, every foeman.

verses.sa:
अयमस्तु धनपतिर्धनानामयं विशां विश्पतिरस्तु राजा ।
अस्मिन्निन्द्र महि वर्चांसि धेह्यवर्चसं कृणुहि शत्रुमस्य॥
verses.tr: ayamastu dhanapatirdhanānāmayaṃ viśāṃ viśpatirastu rājā asminnindra mahi varcāṃsi dhehyavarcasaṃ kṛṇuhi śatrumasya
verses.en: Let him be treasure-lord of goodly treasures, let him as King be master of the people. Grant unto him great power and might, O Indra, and strip his enemy of strength and vigour.

verses.sa:
अस्मै द्यावापृथिवी भूरि वामं दुहाथां घर्मदुघे इव धेनू।
अयं राजा प्रिय इन्द्रस्य भूयात् प्रियो गवामोषधीनां पशूनाम्॥
verses.tr: asmai dyāvāpṛthivī bhūri vāmaṃ duhāthāṃ gharmadughe iva dhenū ayaṃ rājā priya indrasya bhūyāt priyo gavāmoṣadhīnāṃ paśūnām
verses.en: Like milch-kine yielding milk for warm libations, pour, Heaven and Earth! on him full many a blessing. May he as King be Indra's well-beloved, the darling of the kine, the plants, the cattle.

verses.sa:
युनज्मि त उत्तरावन्तमिन्द्रं येन जयन्ति न पराजयन्ते ।
यस्त्वा करदेकवृषं जनानामुत राज्ञामुत्तमं मानवानाम्॥
verses.tr: yunajmi ta uttarāvantamindraṃ yena jayanti na parājayante yastvā karadekavṛṣaṃ janānāmuta rājñāmuttamaṃ mānavānām
verses.en: I join in league with thee victorious Indra, with whom men conquer and are ne'er defeated. He shall make thee the folk's sole lord and leader, shall make thee highest of all human rulers.

verses.sa:
उत्तरस्त्वमधरे ते सपत्ना ये के च राजन् प्रतिशत्रवस्ते ।
एकवृष इन्द्रसखा जिगीवां छत्रूयतामा भरा भोजनानि॥
verses.tr: uttarastvamadhare te sapatnā ye ke ca rājan pratiśatravaste ekavṛṣa indrasakhā jigīvāṃ chatrūyatāmā bharā bhojanāni
verses.en: Supreme art thou, beneath thee are thy rivals, and all, O King, who were thine adversaries. Sole lord and leader and allied with Indra, bring, conqueror, thy foemen's goods and treasures.

verses.sa:
सिंहप्रतीको विशो अद्धि सर्वा व्याघ्रप्रतीकोऽव बाधस्व शत्रून्।
एकवृष इन्द्रसखा जिगीवां छत्रूयतामा खिदा भोजनानि॥
verses.tr: siṃhapratīko viśo addhi sarvā vyāghrapratīko'va bādhasva śatrūn ekavṛṣa indrasakhā jigīvāṃ chatrūyatāmā khidā bhojanāni
verses.en: Consume, with lion aspect, all their hamlets, with tiger aspect, drive away thy foemen. Sole lord and leader and allied with Indra, seize, conqueror, thine enemies' possessions.

sections.label: A magnification of Agni and a prayer for his protection
sections.name: Hymn 23

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्मन्वे प्रथमस्य प्रचेतसः पाञ्चजन्यस्य बहुधा यमिन्धते ।
विशो विशः प्रविशिवांसमीमहे स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: agnermanve prathamasya pracetasaḥ pāñcajanyasya bahudhā yamindhate viśo viśaḥ praviśivāṃsamīmahe sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: I Fix my heart on wise and ancient Agni, the Five Tribes' Lord, in many a place enkindled. We seek him who hath entered all our houses. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यथा हव्यं वहसि जातवेदो यथा यज्ञं कल्पयसि प्रजानन्।
एवा देवेभ्यः सुमतिं न आ वह स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yathā havyaṃ vahasi jātavedo yathā yajñaṃ kalpayasi prajānan evā devebhyaḥ sumatiṃ na ā vaha sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: As thou conveyest offering?) Jatavedas! and fashion-est the sacrifice with knowledge, So bear thou to the Gods the prayer we utter. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यामन्यामन्नुपयुक्तं वहिष्ठं कर्मन्कर्मन्नाभगम् ।
अग्निमीडे रक्षोहणं यज्ञवॄधं घृताहुतं स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yāmanyāmannupayuktaṃ vahiṣṭhaṃ karmankarmannābhagam agnimīḍe rakṣohaṇaṃ yajñavṝdhaṃ ghṛtāhutaṃ sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: I pray to Agni in each act successful, employed in every sacrifice, the strongest, Fiend-slayer, served with fatness, strengthening worship. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
सुजातं जातवेदसमग्निं वैश्वानरं विभुम्।
हव्यवाहं हवामहे स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: sujātaṃ jātavedasamagniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ vibhum havyavāhaṃ havāmahe sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: We invoke the oblation-bearer, well-born Agni Jatavedas, Him, Vaisvanara, almighty. May he set us free from trouble.

verses.sa:
येन ऋषयो बलमद्योतयन् युजा येनासुराणामयुवन्त मायाः ।
येनाग्निना पणीनिन्द्रो जिगाय स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yena ṛṣayo balamadyotayan yujā yenāsurāṇāmayuvanta māyāḥ yenāgninā paṇīnindro jigāya sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: With whom as friend the Rishis gave their power new splendour, with whom they kept aloof the Asuras' devices, Agni, with whom Indra subdued the Panis. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
येन देवा अमृतमन्वविन्दन् येनौषधीर्मधुमतीरकृण्वन्।
येन देवाः स्व१राभरन्त्स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yena devā amṛtamanvavindan yenauṣadhīrmadhumatīrakṛṇvan yena devāḥ sva1rābharantsa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Through whom the Gods discovered life eternal, through whom they stored the plants with pleasant juices, Through whom they brought to men the light of heaven. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यस्येदं प्रदिशि यद् विरोचते यज्जातं जनितव्यंऽ च केवलम्।
स्तौम्यग्निं नाथितो जोहवीमि स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yasyedaṃ pradiśi yad virocate yajjātaṃ janitavyaṃ' ca kevalam staumyagniṃ nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: I, suppliant, praise and ever call on Agni, sole Lord of all this world, of all that shineth, Of what exists and shall exist hereafter. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

sections.label: A hymn of prayer and praise to Indra
sections.name: Hymn 24

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य मन्महे शश्वदिदस्य मन्महे वृत्रघ्न स्तोमा उप मेम आगुः ।
यो दाशुषः सुकृतो हवमेति स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: indrasya manmahe śaśvadidasya manmahe vṛtraghna stomā upa mema āguḥ yo dāśuṣaḥ sukṛto havameti sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: I Think of Indra, only him for ever, fiend-slayer May these lauds of mine come near him. He cometh to the pious offerer's calling. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
य उग्रीणामुग्रबाहुर्ययुर्यो दानवानां बलमारुरोज ।
येन जिताः सिन्धवो येन गावः स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: ya ugrīṇāmugrabāhuryayuryo dānavānāṃ balamāruroja yena jitāḥ sindhavo yena gāvaḥ sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Who with strong arms overcame his strong opponents, who broke and crushed the power of the demons, Who won the rivers and the kine in battle. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यश्चर्षणिप्रो वृषभः स्वर्विद् यस्मै ग्रावाणः प्रवदन्ति नृम्णम्।
यस्याध्वरः सप्तहोता मदिष्ठः स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yaścarṣaṇipro vṛṣabhaḥ svarvid yasmai grāvāṇaḥ pravadanti nṛmṇam yasyādhvaraḥ saptahotā madiṣṭhaḥ sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ruler of men, finder of light, the hero: the pressing-stones declare his valour, master Of sweetest sacrifice with seven Hotars. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यस्य वशास ऋषभास उक्षणो यस्मै मीयन्ते स्वरवः स्वर्विदे ।
यस्मै शुक्रः पवते ब्रह्मशुम्भितः स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yasya vaśāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo yasmai mīyante svaravaḥ svarvide yasmai śukraḥ pavate brahmaśumbhitaḥ sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: The lord of barren cows and bulls and oxen, finder of light for whom the posts are planted, For whom the bright juice flows cleansed by devotion. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यस्य जुष्टिं सोमिनः कामयन्ते यं हवन्त इषुमन्तं गविष्टौ ।
यस्मिन्नर्कः शिश्रिये यस्मिन्नोजः स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yasya juṣṭiṃ sominaḥ kāmayante yaṃ havanta iṣumantaṃ gaviṣṭau yasminnarkaḥ śiśriye yasminnojaḥ sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Whose favour those desire who offer Soma, whom, arrow-bearer, men invoke in battle, On whom the hymn depends, in whom is power. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यः प्रथमः कर्मकृत्याय जज्ञे यस्य वीर्यंऽ प्रथमस्यानुबुद्धम्।
येनोद्यतो वज्रोऽभ्यायताहिं स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ prathamaḥ karmakṛtyāya jajñe yasya vīryaṃ' prathamasyānubuddham yenodyato vajro'bhyāyatāhiṃ sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Who was born, first, for active operation, whose valour as the first hath been awakened, Who raised his bolt when he encountered Ahi. May he deliver as from grief and trouble. A hymn of praise and prayer to Indra.

verses.sa:
यः संग्रामान्नयति सं युधे वशी यः पुष्टानि संसृजति द्वयानि ।
स्तौमीन्द्रं नाथितो जोहवीमि स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ saṃgrāmānnayati saṃ yudhe vaśī yaḥ puṣṭāni saṃsṛjati dvayāni staumīndraṃ nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Strong Lord, who leadeth hosts to meet for battle, who sendeth riches both of earth and heaven,—I, suppliant, praise and ever call on Indra. May he deliver us from grief and trouble.

sections.label: Indra wis Run. Pace. A hymn of prayer and praise to Vayu and Savitar
sections.name: Hymn 25

verses.sa:
वायोः सवितुर्विदथानि मन्महे यावात्मन्वद् विशथो यौ च रक्षथः ।
यौ विश्वस्य परिभू बभूवथुस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: vāyoḥ saviturvidathāni manmahe yāvātmanvad viśatho yau ca rakṣathaḥ yau viśvasya paribhū babhūvathustau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: I Think on Vayu's and Savitar's holy rites, ye twain who penetrate and guard the living world: Ye who have come to be this All's pervaders, deliver us, ye two, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
ययोः संख्याता वरिमा पार्थिवानि याभ्यां रजो युपितमन्तरिक्षे ।
ययोः प्रायं नान्वानशे कश्चन तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yayoḥ saṃkhyātā varimā pārthivāni yābhyāṃ rajo yupitamantarikṣe yayoḥ prāyaṃ nānvānaśe kaścana tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye who have counted up the earth's expanses, and in the sky smoothed out the air's mid-region, Whose going-forth hath ne'er been reached by any, deliver us, ye two, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
तव व्रते नि विशन्ते जनासस्त्वय्युदिते प्रेरते चित्रभानो ।
युवं वायो सविता च भुवनानि रक्षथस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: tava vrate ni viśante janāsastvayyudite prerate citrabhāno yuvaṃ vāyo savitā ca bhuvanāni rakṣathastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Beauteously bright! men rest in thy dominion when thou hast risen up and hastened onward. Ye, Vayu, Savitar, preserve all creatures. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
अपेतो वायो सविता च दुष्कृतमप रक्षांसि शिमिदां च सेधतम्।
सं ह्यू३र्जया सृजथः सं बलेन तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: apeto vāyo savitā ca duṣkṛtamapa rakṣāṃsi śimidāṃ ca sedhatam saṃ hyū3rjayā sṛjathaḥ saṃ balena tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Hence, Vayu, Savitar, drive evil action, chase Simida away, drive off the demons. Ye give us store of energy and power. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
रयिं मे पोषं सवितोत वायुस्तनू दक्षमा सुवतां सुशेवम्।
अयक्ष्मतातिं मह इह धत्तं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: rayiṃ me poṣaṃ savitota vāyustanū dakṣamā suvatāṃ suśevam ayakṣmatātiṃ maha iha dhattaṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Of their own selves let Savitar and Vayu send favourable strength and wealth and plenty. Here give us perfect freedom from consumption. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
प्र सुमतिं सवितर्वाय ऊतये महस्वन्तं मत्सरं मादयाथः ।
अर्वाग् वामस्य प्रवतो नि यच्छतं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: pra sumatiṃ savitarvāya ūtaye mahasvantaṃ matsaraṃ mādayāthaḥ arvāg vāmasya pravato ni yacchataṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye, Savitar and Vayu, to assist us, enjoy the hymn and the delightful cheerer. Come hither downward from the stream of blessing. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
उप श्रेष्ठा न आशिषो देवयोर्धामन्नस्थिरन्।
स्तौमि देवं सवितारं च वायुं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: upa śreṣṭhā na āśiṣo devayordhāmannasthiran staumi devaṃ savitāraṃ ca vāyuṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Like noblest benisons they have stayed in the God-loving man's abode. I glorify bright Savitar and Vayu. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

sections.label: A hymn to Heaven and Earth
sections.name: Hymn 26

verses.sa:
मन्वे वां द्यावापृथिवी सुभोजसौ सचेतसौ ये अप्रथेथाममिता योजनानि ।
प्रतिष्ठे ह्यभवतं वसूनां ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: manve vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī subhojasau sacetasau ye aprathethāmamitā yojanāni pratiṣṭhe hyabhavataṃ vasūnāṃ te no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: O Heaven and Earth, I think on you, wise, givers of abundant gifts, ye who through measureless expanses have spread forth. For ye are seats and homes of goodly treasures. Deliver us, ye twain from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
प्रतिष्ठे ह्यभवत वसूनां प्रवृद्धे देवी सुभगे उरूची ।
द्यावापृथिवी भवतं मे स्योने ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: pratiṣṭhe hyabhavata vasūnāṃ pravṛddhe devī subhage urūcī dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Yea, seats and homes are ye of goodly treasures, grown strong, divine, blessed, and far-extending. To me, O Heaven and Earth, be ye auspicious, Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
असन्तापे सुतपसौ हुवेऽहमुर्वी गम्भीरे कविभिर्नमस्येऽ।
द्यावापृथिवी भवतं मे स्योने ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: asantāpe sutapasau huve'hamurvī gambhīre kavibhirnamasye' dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: I call on you who warm and cause no sorrow, deep, spacious, meet to be adored by poets. To me, O Heaven and Earth, be ye auspicious. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
ये अमृतं बिभृथो ये हवींषि ये स्रोत्या बिभृथो ये मनुष्याऽन्।
द्यावापृथिवी भवतं मे स्योने ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: ye amṛtaṃ bibhṛtho ye havīṃṣi ye srotyā bibhṛtho ye manuṣyā'n dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye who maintain Amrit and sacrifices, ye who support rivers and human beings, To (me, O Heaven and Earth, be ye auspicious. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
ये उस्रिया बिभृथो ये वनस्पतीन् ययोर्वां विश्वा भुवनान्यन्तः ।
द्यावापृथिवी भवतं मे स्योने ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
