verses.tr: ye usriyā bibhṛtho ye vanaspatīn yayorvāṃ viśvā bhuvanānyantaḥ dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye by whom cows and forest trees are cherished, within whose range all creatures are included, 'To me, O Heaven and Earth, be ye auspicious. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
ये कीलालेन तर्पयथो ये घृतेन याभ्यामृते न किं चन शक्नुवन्ति ।
द्यावापृथिवी भवतं मे स्योने ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: ye kīlālena tarpayatho ye ghṛtena yābhyāmṛte na kiṃ cana śaknuvanti dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye who delight in nectar and in fatness, ye without whom men have no strength or power, To me, O Heaven and Earth, be ye auspicious. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यन्मेदमभिशोचति येनयेन वा कृतं पौरुषेयान्न दैवात्।
स्तौमि द्यावापृथिवी नाथितो जोहवीमि ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yanmedamabhiśocati yenayena vā kṛtaṃ pauruṣeyānna daivāt staumi dyāvāpṛthivī nāthito johavīmi te no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: The grief that pains me here, whoever caused it, not sent by fate, hath sprung from human action. I, suppliant, praise Heaven, Earth, and oft invoke them. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

sections.label: A hymn to the Maruts
sections.name: Hymn 27

verses.sa:
मरुतां मन्वे अधि मे ब्रुवन्तु प्रेमं वाजं वाजसाते अवन्तु ।
आशूनिव सुयमानह्व ऊतये ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: marutāṃ manve adhi me bruvantu premaṃ vājaṃ vājasāte avantu āśūniva suyamānahva ūtaye te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: I Think upon the Maruts: may they bless me, may they assist me to this wealth in battle. I call them like swift well-trained steeds to help us. May they deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
उत्समक्षितं व्यचन्ति ये सदा य आसिञ्चन्ति रसमोषधीषु ।
पुरो दधे मरुतः पृश्निमातृंस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: utsamakṣitaṃ vyacanti ye sadā ya āsiñcanti rasamoṣadhīṣu puro dadhe marutaḥ pṛśnimātṛṃste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Those who surround the never-failing fountain for ever, and bedew the plants with moisture, The Maruts, Prisni's sons, I chiefly honour. May they deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
पयो धेनूनां रसमोषधीनां जवमर्वतां कवयो य इन्वथ ।
शग्मा भवन्तु मरुतो नः स्योनास्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: payo dhenūnāṃ rasamoṣadhīnāṃ javamarvatāṃ kavayo ya invatha śagmā bhavantu maruto naḥ syonāste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Bards, who invigorate the milk of milch-kine, the sap of growing plants, the speed of coursers—To us may the strong Maruts be auspicious. May they deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
अपः समुद्राद् दिवमुद् वहन्ति दिवस्पृथिवीमभि ये सृजन्ति ।
ये अद्भिरीशाना मरुतश्चरन्ति ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: apaḥ samudrād divamud vahanti divaspṛthivīmabhi ye sṛjanti ye adbhirīśānā marutaścaranti te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: They who raised water from the sea to heaven and send it from the sky to earth in showers, The Maruts who move mighty with their waters, may they deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
ये कीलालेन तर्पयन्ति ये घृतेन ये वा वयो मेदसा संसृजन्ति ।
ये अद्भिरीशाना मरुतो वर्षयन्ति ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: ye kīlālena tarpayanti ye ghṛtena ye vā vayo medasā saṃsṛjanti ye adbhirīśānā maruto varṣayanti te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: They who delight in nectar and in fatness, they who bestow upon us health and vigour, The Maruts who rain mighty with their waters, may they deliver us from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यदीदिदं मरुतो मारुतेन यदि देवा दैव्येनेदृगार ।
यूयमीशिध्वे वसवस्तस्य निष्कृतेस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yadīdidaṃ maruto mārutena yadi devā daivyenedṛgāra yūyamīśidhve vasavastasya niṣkṛteste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Whether with stormy might the Maruts stablished this All, or Gods with their celestial power, Ye, kindly Gods, are able to restore it. May they deliver us from grief and trouble,

verses.sa:
तिग्ममनीकं विदितं सहस्वन्मारुतं शर्धः पृतनासूग्रम्।
स्तौमि मरुतो नाथितो जोहवीमि ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: tigmamanīkaṃ viditaṃ sahasvanmārutaṃ śardhaḥ pṛtanāsūgram staumi maruto nāthito johavīmi te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Potent in battles is the Maruts' army, impetuous train, well-known, exceeding mighty. I, suppliant, praise and oft invoke the Maruts. May they deliver us from grief and trouble.

sections.label: A hymn to Bhava and Sarva
sections.name: Hymn 28

verses.sa:
भवाशर्वौ मन्वे वां तस्य वित्तं ययोर्वामिदं प्रदिशि यद् विरोचते ।
यावस्येशाथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: bhavāśarvau manve vāṃ tasya vittaṃ yayorvāmidaṃ pradiśi yad virocate yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: I Reverence you—mark this—Bhava and Sarva, ye under whose control is this that shineth, Lords of this world both quadruped and biped. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
ययोरभ्यभ्व उत यद् दूरे चिद् यौ विदिताविषुभृतामसिष्ठौ ।
यावस्येशाथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yayorabhyabhva uta yad dūre cid yau viditāviṣubhṛtāmasiṣṭhau yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Lords of all near and even of what is distant, famed as the best and skilfullest of archers, Lords of this world both quadruped and biped, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
सहस्राक्षौ वृत्रहना हुवेहं दूरेगव्यूती स्तुवन्नेम्युग्रौ।
यावस्येशाथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: sahasrākṣau vṛtrahanā huvehaṃ dūregavyūtī stuvannemyugrau yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Thousand-eyed foe-destroyers, I invoke you, still praising you the strong, of wide dominion: Lords of this world both quadruped and biped, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यावारेभाथे बहु साकमग्रे प्र चेदस्राष्ट्रमभिभां जनेषु ।
यावस्येशाथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yāvārebhāthe bahu sākamagre pra cedasrāṣṭramabhibhāṃ janeṣu yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye who of old wrought many a deed in concert, and showed among mankind unhappy omens; Lords of this world both quadruped and biped, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
ययोर्वधान्नापपद्यते कश्चनान्तर्देवेषूत मानुषेषु ।
यावस्येशाथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yayorvadhānnāpapadyate kaścanāntardeveṣūta mānuṣeṣu yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye from the stroke of whose destroying weapon not one among the Gods or men escapeth, Lords of this world both quadruped and biped, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यः कृत्याकृन्मूलकृद् यातुधानो नि तस्मिन् धत्तं वज्रमुग्रौ।
यावस्येशाथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ kṛtyākṛnmūlakṛd yātudhāno ni tasmin dhattaṃ vajramugrau yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Hurl your bolt, strong Gods, at the Yatudhana, him who makes ready roots and deals in magic: Lords of this world both quadruped and biped, deliver us, ye twain from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
अधि नो ब्रूतं पृतनासूग्रौ सं वज्रेण सृजतं यः किमीदी।
स्तौमि भवाशर्वौ नाथितो जोहवीमि तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: adhi no brūtaṃ pṛtanāsūgrau saṃ vajreṇa sṛjataṃ yaḥ kimīdī staumi bhavāśarvau nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Comfort and aid us, ye strong Gods, in battle at each Kimidin send your bolt of thunder. I, j suppliant, praise and ever call on Bhava and Sarva. Set us free from grief and trouble.

sections.label: A hymn to Mitra-Varuna
sections.name: Hymn 29

verses.sa:
मन्वे वां मित्रावरुणावृतावृधौ सचेतसौ द्रुह्वणो यौ नुदेथे ।
प्र सत्यावानमवथो भरेषु तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: manve vāṃ mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhau sacetasau druhvaṇo yau nudethe pra satyāvānamavatho bhareṣu tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: You twain, O Mitra, Varuna, I honour, Law-strengtheners, wise, who drive away oppressors. Ye who protect the truthful in his battles, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
सचेतसौ द्रुह्वणो यौ नुदेथे प्र सत्यावानमवथो भरेषु ।
यौ गच्छथो नृचक्षसौ बभ्रुणा सुतं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: sacetasau druhvaṇo yau nudethe pra satyāvānamavatho bhareṣu yau gacchatho nṛcakṣasau babhruṇā sutaṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye the wise Gods who drive away oppressors, ye who protect the truthful in his battles, Who come, men's guards, to juice pressed forth by Babhru, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यावङ्गिरसमवथो यावगस्तिं मित्रावरुणा जमदग्निमत्रिम्।
यौ कश्यपमवथो यौ वसिष्ठं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yāvaṅgirasamavatho yāvagastiṃ mitrāvaruṇā jamadagnimatrim yau kaśyapamavatho yau vasiṣṭhaṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna who help Agasti, Atri, and Angiras, and Jamadagni, Ye who help Kasyapa, who help Vasishtha, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यौ श्यावाश्वमवथो वाध्र्यश्वं मित्रावरुणा पुरुमीढमत्रिम्।
यौ विमदमवथः सप्तवध्रिं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yau śyāvāśvamavatho vādhryaśvaṃ mitrāvaruṇā purumīḍhamatrim yau vimadamavathaḥ saptavadhriṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna, who help Syavasva, Atri, and Purumilha, and Vadhryasva, Ye who help Vimada and Saptavadhri, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यो भरद्वाजमवथो यौ गविष्ठिरं विश्वामित्रं वरुण मित्र कुत्सम्।
यौ कक्षीवन्तमवथः प्रोत कण्वं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yo bharadvājamavatho yau gaviṣṭhiraṃ viśvāmitraṃ varuṇa mitra kutsam yau kakṣīvantamavathaḥ prota kaṇvaṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye, Varuna, Mitra, who give aid to Kutsa, Gavishthira, Bharadvaja, Visvamitra, Who help Kakshivan and give aid to Kanva, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
यौ मेधातिथिमवथो यौ त्रिशोकं मित्रावरुणावुशनां काव्यं यौ।
यौ गोतममवथः प्रोत मुद्गलं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yau medhātithimavatho yau triśokaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvuśanāṃ kāvyaṃ yau yau gotamamavathaḥ prota mudgalaṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye, Mitra, Varuna, who help Trisoka, Medhatithi, and Usana son of Kavi, Ye, Gotama's and Mudgala's protectors, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and and trouble.

verses.sa:
ययो रथः सत्यवर्त्मर्जुरश्मिर्मिथुया चरन्तमभियाति दूषयन्।
स्तौमि मित्रावरुणौ नाथितो जोहवीमि तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः॥
verses.tr: yayo rathaḥ satyavartmarjuraśmirmithuyā carantamabhiyāti dūṣayan staumi mitrāvaruṇau nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Whose straight-reined car that keeps the track of goodness assails and ruins him who walks perversely—I, suppliant, praise with constant invocation Mitra and Varuna. Save us from affliction.

sections.label: A glorification of Vak or Speech
sections.name: Hymn 30

verses.sa:
अहं रुद्रेभिर्वसुभिश्चराम्यहमादित्यैरुत विश्वदेवैः ।
अहं मित्रावरुणोभा बिभर्म्यहमिन्द्राग्नी अहमश्विनोभा॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ rudrebhirvasubhiścarāmyahamādityairuta viśvadevaiḥ ahaṃ mitrāvaruṇobhā bibharmyahamindrāgnī ahamaśvinobhā
verses.en: I Travel with the Rudras and the Vasus, with the Adityas and All-gods I wander. I hold aloft both Varuna and Mitra, I hold aloft Indra and both the Asvins.

verses.sa:
अहं राष्ट्री संगमनी वसूनां चिकितुषी प्रथमा यज्ञियानाम्।
तां मा देवा व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा भूरिस्थात्रां भूर्यावेशयन्तः॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ rāṣṭrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ cikituṣī prathamā yajñiyānām tāṃ mā devā vyadadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhātrāṃ bhūryāveśayantaḥ
verses.en: I am the Queen, the gatherer-up of treasures, most thoughtful, first of those who merit worship. The Gods, making me enter many places, in divers spots have set mine habitation.

verses.sa:
अहमेव स्वयमिदं वदामि जुष्टं देवानामुत मानुषाणाम्।
यं कामये तन्तमुग्रं कृणोमि तं ब्रह्माणं तमृषिं तं सुमेधाम्॥
verses.tr: ahameva svayamidaṃ vadāmi juṣṭaṃ devānāmuta mānuṣāṇām yaṃ kāmaye tantamugraṃ kṛṇomi taṃ brahmāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ taṃ sumedhām
verses.en: I, verily, myself announce and utter the word that Gods and men alike shall welcome. I make the man I love exceeding mighty, make him a sage, a Rishi, and a Brahman.

verses.sa:
मया सोऽन्नमत्ति यो विपश्यति यः प्राणति य ईं शृणोत्युक्तम्।
अमन्तवो मां त उप क्षियन्ति श्रुधि श्रुत श्रुद्धेयं ते वदामि॥
verses.tr: mayā so'nnamatti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇati ya īṃ śṛṇotyuktam amantavo māṃ ta upa kṣiyanti śrudhi śruta śruddheyaṃ te vadāmi
verses.en: Through me alone all eat the food that feeds them, each man who sees, breathes, hears the word out-spoken. They know it not, but yet they dwell beside me. Hear, one and all, the truth as I declare it.

verses.sa:
अहं रुद्राय धनुरा तनोमि ब्रह्मद्विषे शरवे हन्तवा उ ।
अहं जनाय समदं कृणोम्यहं द्यावापृथिवी आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ rudrāya dhanurā tanomi brahmadviṣe śarave hantavā u ahaṃ janāya samadaṃ kṛṇomyahaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa
verses.en: I bend the bow for Rudra that his arrow may strike and slay the hater of devotion. I rouse and order battle for the people, and I have penetrated Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अहं सोममाहनसं बिभर्म्यहं त्वष्टारमुत पूषणं भगम्।
अहं दधामि द्रविणा हविष्मते सुप्राव्या३ यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ somamāhanasaṃ bibharmyahaṃ tvaṣṭāramuta pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇā haviṣmate suprāvyā3 yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: I cherish and sustain high-swelling Soma, and Tvashtar I support, Pushan, and Bhaga. I load with wealth the zealous sacrificer who pours the juice and offers his oblation.

verses.sa:
अहं सुवे पितरमस्य मूर्धन् मम योनिरप्स्व१न्तः समुद्रे।
ततो वि तिष्ठे भुवनानि विश्वोतामूं द्यां वर्ष्मणोप स्पृशामि॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ suve pitaramasya mūrdhan mama yonirapsva1ntaḥ samudre tato vi tiṣṭhe bhuvanāni viśvotāmūṃ dyāṃ varṣmaṇopa spṛśāmi
verses.en: On the world's summit I bring forth the Father: my home is in the waters, in the ocean. Thence I extend o'er all existing creatures, and touch even yonder heaven with my forehead.

verses.sa:
अहमेव वात इव प्र वाम्यारभमाणा भुवनानि विश्वा ।
परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्यौतावती महिम्ना सं बभूव॥
verses.tr: ahameva vāta iva pra vāmyārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā paro divā para enā pṛthivyautāvatī mahimnā saṃ babhūva
verses.en: I breathe a strong breath like the wind and tempest, the while I hold together all existence. Beyond this wide earth and beyond the heavens I have become so mighty in my grandeur.

sections.label: A hymn to Manyu or Wrath
sections.name: Hymn 31

verses.sa:
त्वया मन्यो सरथमारुजन्तो हर्षमाणा हृषितासो मरुत्वन्।
तिग्मेषव आयुधा संशिशाना उप प्र यन्तु नरो अग्निरूपाः॥
verses.tr: tvayā manyo sarathamārujanto harṣamāṇā hṛṣitāso marutvan tigmeṣava āyudhā saṃśiśānā upa pra yantu naro agnirūpāḥ
verses.en: Borne on with thee, O Manyu girt by Maruts, let our brave men, impetuous, bursting forward, March on, like flames of fire in form, exulting, with pointed arrows, sharpening their weapons.

verses.sa:
अग्निरिव मन्यो त्विषितः सहस्व सेनानीर्नः सहुरे हूत एधि ।
हत्वाय शत्रून् वि भजस्व वेद ओजो मिमानो वि मृधो नुदस्व॥
verses.tr: agniriva manyo tviṣitaḥ sahasva senānīrnaḥ sahure hūta edhi hatvāya śatrūn vi bhajasva veda ojo mimāno vi mṛdho nudasva
verses.en: Flashing like fire, be thou, O conquering Manyu, invoked, O victor, as our army's leader. Slay thou our foes, distribute their possessions: show forth thy vigour, scatter those who hate us.

verses.sa:
सहस्व मन्यो अभिमातिमस्मै रुजन् मृणन् प्रमृणन् प्रेहि शत्रून्।
उग्रं ते पाजो नन्वा रुरुध्रे वशी वशं नयासा एकज त्वम्॥
verses.tr: sahasva manyo abhimātimasmai rujan mṛṇan pramṛṇan prehi śatrūn ugraṃ te pājo nanvā rurudhre vaśī vaśaṃ nayāsā ekaja tvam
verses.en: O Manyu, overcome those who assail us. On! breaking, slaying, crushing down the foemen. They have not hindered thine impetuous vigour: mighty! sole-born! reduce them to subjection.

verses.sa:
एको बहूनामसि मन्य ईडिता विशंविशं युद्धाय सं शिशाधि ।
अकृत्तरुक् त्वया युजा वयं द्युमन्तं घोषं विजयाय कृण्मसि॥
verses.tr: eko bahūnāmasi manya īḍitā viśaṃviśaṃ yuddhāya saṃ śiśādhi akṛttaruk tvayā yujā vayaṃ dyumantaṃ ghoṣaṃ vijayāya kṛṇmasi
verses.en: Alone of many thou art worshipped, Manyu: sharpen the spirit of each clan for combat. With thee to aid, O thou of perfect splendour, we raise the glorious battle-shout for conquest.

verses.sa:
विजेषकृदिन्द्र इवानवब्रवो३ऽस्माकं मन्यो अधिपा भवेह।
प्रियं ते नाम सहुरे गृणीमसि विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आबभूथ॥
verses.tr: vijeṣakṛdindra ivānavabravo3'smākaṃ manyo adhipā bhaveha priyaṃ te nāma sahure gṛṇīmasi vidmā tamutsaṃ yata ābabhūtha
verses.en: Unyielding, bringing victory like Indra, O Manyu, be thou here our sovran ruler. To thy dear name, O victor, we sing praises: we know the spring from which thou art come hither.

verses.sa:
आभूत्या सहजा वज्र सायक सहो बिभर्षि सहभूत उत्तरम्।
क्रत्वा नो मन्यो सह मेद्येऽधि महाधनस्य पुरुहूत संसृजि॥
verses.tr: ābhūtyā sahajā vajra sāyaka saho bibharṣi sahabhūta uttaram kratvā no manyo saha medye'dhi mahādhanasya puruhūta saṃsṛji
verses.en: Twin-borne with power, destructive bolt of thunder! the highest conquering might is thine, subduer! Be friendly to us in thy spirit, Manyu! O much-invoked, in shock of mighty battle!

verses.sa:
संसृष्टं धनमुभयं समाकृतमस्मभ्यं धत्तां वरुणश्च मन्युः ।
भियो दधाना हॄदयेषु शत्रवः पराजितासो अप नि लयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dhanamubhayaṃ samākṛtamasmabhyaṃ dhattāṃ varuṇaśca manyuḥ bhiyo dadhānā hṝdayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitāso apa ni layantām
verses.en: For spoil let Varuna and Manyu give us the wealth of both sides gathered and collected; And let our enemies with stricken spirits, o'erwhelmed with terror, sling away defeated.

sections.label: A hymn to Manyu
sections.name: Hymn 32

verses.sa:
यस्ते मन्योऽविधद् वज्र सायक सह ओजः पुष्यति विश्वमानुषक्।
साह्याम दासमार्यं त्वया युजा वयं सहस्कृतेन सहसा सहस्वता॥
verses.tr: yaste manyo'vidhad vajra sāyaka saha ojaḥ puṣyati viśvamānuṣak sāhyāma dāsamāryaṃ tvayā yujā vayaṃ sahaskṛtena sahasā sahasvatā
verses.en: He who hath reverenced thee, Manyu, destructive bolt! breeds for himself forthwith all conquering energy. Arya and Dasa will we conquer with thine aid, with thee the conqueror, with conquest conquest-sped.

verses.sa:
मन्युरिन्द्रो मन्युरेवास देवो मन्युर्होता वरुणो जातवेदाः ।
मन्युर्विश ईडते मानुषीर्याः पाहि नो मन्यो तपसा सजोषाः॥
verses.tr: manyurindro manyurevāsa devo manyurhotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ manyurviśa īḍate mānuṣīryāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sajoṣāḥ
verses.en: Manyu was Indra, yea, the God was Manyu; Manyu was Hotar, Varuna, Jatavedas. The tribes of human lineage worship Manyu. Accordant, with thy fervour, Manyu! guard us.

verses.sa:
अभीऽहि मन्यो तवसस्तवीयान् तपसा युजा वि जहि शत्रून्।
अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहा च विश्वा वसून्या भरा त्वं नः॥
verses.tr: abhī'hi manyo tavasastavīyān tapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasūnyā bharā tvaṃ naḥ
verses.en: Come hither, Manyu, mightier than the mighty: smite, with thy fervour for ally, our foemen. Slayer of foes, of Vritra, and of Dasyu, bring thou to us all kinds of wealth and treasure.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि मन्यो अभिभूत्योजाः स्वयंभूर्भामो अभिमातिषाहः ।
विश्वचर्षणिः सहुरिः सहीयानस्मास्वोजः पृतनासु धेहि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi manyo abhibhūtyojāḥ svayaṃbhūrbhāmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ viśvacarṣaṇiḥ sahuriḥ sahīyānasmāsvojaḥ pṛtanāsu dhehi
verses.en: For thou art, Manyu, of surpassing vigour, fierce, queller of the foe, and self-existent, Shared by all men, victorious, subduer: vouchsafe to us superior strength in battles.

verses.sa:
अभागः सन्नप परेतो अस्मि तव क्रत्वा तविषस्य प्रचेतः ।
तं त्वा मन्यो अक्रतुर्जिहीडाहं स्वा तनूर्बलदावा न एहि॥
verses.tr: abhāgaḥ sannapa pareto asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetaḥ taṃ tvā manyo akraturjihīḍāhaṃ svā tanūrbaladāvā na ehi
verses.en: I have departed still without a portion, wise God! according to thy will, the mighty. I, feeble man, was wroth with thee, O Manyu. Come in thy proper form and give us vigour.

verses.sa:
अयं ते अस्म्युप न एह्यर्वाङ् प्रतीचीनः सहुरे विश्वदावन्।
मन्यो वज्रिन्नभि न आ ववृत्स्व हनाव दस्यूंरुत बोध्यापेः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te asmyupa na ehyarvāṅ pratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadāvan manyo vajrinnabhi na ā vavṛtsva hanāva dasyūṃruta bodhyāpeḥ
verses.en: Come hither, I am all thine own: advancing, turn thou to me, victorious, all-bestowing. Come to me, Manyu, wielder of the thunder: bethink thee of thy friend, and slay the Dasyus.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रेहि दक्षिणतो भवा नोऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि ।
जुहोमि ते धरुणं मध्वो अग्रमुभावुपांशु प्रथमा पिबाव॥
verses.tr: abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā no'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri juhomi te dharuṇaṃ madhvo agramubhāvupāṃśu prathamā pibāva
verses.en: Approach, and on our right hand hold thy station, then let us slay a multitude of foemen. The best of meath I offer to support thee: may we be first to drink thereof in quiet.

sections.label: A prayer to Agni for protection and prosperity
sections.name: Hymn 33

verses.sa:
अप नः शोशुचदघमग्ने शुशुग्ध्या रयिम्।
अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: apa naḥ śośucadaghamagne śuśugdhyā rayim apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: Chasing our pain with splendid light, O Agni, shine thou wealth on us. His lustre flash our pain away!

verses.sa:
सुक्षेत्रिया सुगातुया वसूया च यजामहे ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: For goodly fields, for pleasant homes, for wealth we sacrifice to thee. His lustre flash our pain away!

verses.sa:
प्र यद् भन्दिष्ठ एषां प्रास्माकासश्च सूरयः ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: pra yad bhandiṣṭha eṣāṃ prāsmākāsaśca sūrayaḥ apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: Best praiser of all these be he, and foremost be our noble chiefs. His lustre flash our pain away!

verses.sa:
प्र यत् ते अग्ने सूरयो जायेमहि प्र ते वयम्।
अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: pra yat te agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: So that thy worshipper and we, thine, Agni! in our sons may live. His lustre flash our pain away!

verses.sa:
प्र यदग्नेः सहस्वतो विश्वतो यन्ति भानवः ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: pra yadagneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: As ever-conquering Agni's beams of splendour go to every side, His lustre flash our pain away!

verses.sa:
त्वं हि विश्वतोमुख विश्वतः परिभूरसि ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūrasi apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: To every side thy face is turned, thou art triumphant everywhere. His lustre flash our pain away!

verses.sa:
द्विषो नो विश्वतोमुखाति नावेव पारय ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: dviṣo no viśvatomukhāti nāveva pāraya apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: O thou whose face looks every way, bear off our foes as in a ship. His lustre flash our pain away!

verses.sa:
स नः सिन्धुमिव नावाति पर्ष स्वस्तये ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ sindhumiva nāvāti parṣa svastaye apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: As in a ship across the flood, transport us to felicity. His lustre flash our pain away!

sections.label: Glorification of the Vishtari sacrifice
sections.name: Hymn 34

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मास्य शीर्षं बृहदस्य पृष्ठं वामदेव्यमुदरमोदनस्य ।
छन्दांसि पक्षौ मुखमस्य सत्यं विष्टारी जातस्तपसोऽधि यज्ञः॥
verses.tr: brahmāsya śīrṣaṃ bṛhadasya pṛṣṭhaṃ vāmadevyamudaramodanasya chandāṃsi pakṣau mukhamasya satyaṃ viṣṭārī jātastapaso'dhi yajñaḥ
verses.en: The head of this is prayer, its back the Brihat, Odana's belly is the Vamadevya; Its face reality, its sides the metre, Vishtari sacrifice produced from fervour.

verses.sa:
अनस्थाः पूताः पवनेन शुद्धाः शुचयः शुचिमपि यन्ति लोकम्।
नैषां शिश्नं प्र दहति जातवेदाः स्वर्गे लोके बहु स्त्रैणमेषाम्॥
verses.tr: anasthāḥ pūtāḥ pavanena śuddhāḥ śucayaḥ śucimapi yanti lokam naiṣāṃ śiśnaṃ pra dahati jātavedāḥ svarge loke bahu straiṇameṣām
verses.en: Boneless, cleansed, purified by him who cleanseth, they go resplendent to the world of splendour. Fire burneth not their organ of enjoyment: much pleasure have they in the world of Svarga.

verses.sa:
विष्टारिणमोदनं ये पचन्ति नैनानवर्तिः सचते कदा चन।
आस्ते यम उप याति देवान्त्सं गन्धर्वैर्मदते सोम्येभिः॥
verses.tr: viṣṭāriṇamodanaṃ ye pacanti nainānavartiḥ sacate kadā cana āste yama upa yāti devāntsaṃ gandharvairmadate somyebhiḥ
verses.en: Never doth want or evil fortune visit. those who prepare oblation called Vishtari.. He goes unto the Gods, he dwells with Yama, he joys among Gandharvas meet for Soma.

verses.sa:
विष्टारिणमोदनं ये पचन्ति नैनान् यमः परि मुष्णाति रेतः ।
रथी ह भूत्वा रथयान ईयते पक्षी ह भूत्वाति दिवः समेति॥
verses.tr: viṣṭāriṇamodanaṃ ye pacanti nainān yamaḥ pari muṣṇāti retaḥ rathī ha bhūtvā rathayāna īyate pakṣī ha bhūtvāti divaḥ sameti
verses.en: Yama robs not of generative vigour the men who dress oblation called Vishtari. Borne on his car, a charioteer, he travels: endowed with wings he soars beyond the heavens.

verses.sa:
ष यज्ञानां विततो वहिष्ठो विष्टारिणं पक्त्वा दिवमा विवेश ।
आण्डीकं कुमुदं सं तनोति बिसं शालूकं शफको मुलाली।
एतास्त्वा धारा उप यन्तु सर्वाः स्वर्गे लोके मधुमत् पिन्वमाना उप त्वा तिष्ठन्तु पुष्करिणीः समन्ताः॥
verses.tr: ṣa yajñānāṃ vitato vahiṣṭho viṣṭāriṇaṃ paktvā divamā viveśa āṇḍīkaṃ kumudaṃ saṃ tanoti bisaṃ śālūkaṃ śaphako mulālī etāstvā dhārā upa yantu sarvāḥ svarge loke madhumat pinvamānā upa tvā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samantāḥ
verses.en: Strongest is this, performed, of sacrifices: he hath reached heaven who hath prepared Vishtari. The oval-fruited lotus spreads his fibre: there bloom the nenuphar and water-lilies. Abundant with their overflow of sweetness, these streams shall reach thee in the world of Svarga, whole lakes with lotus-blossom shall approach thee.

verses.sa:
घृतह्रदा मधुकूलाः सुरोदकाः क्षीरेण पूर्णा उदकेन दध्ना।
एतास्त्वा धारा उप यन्तु सर्वाः स्वर्गे लोके मधुमत् पिन्वमाना उप त्वा तिष्ठन्तु पुष्करिणीः समन्ताः॥
verses.tr: ghṛtahradā madhukūlāḥ surodakāḥ kṣīreṇa pūrṇā udakena dadhnā etāstvā dhārā upa yantu sarvāḥ svarge loke madhumat pinvamānā upa tvā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samantāḥ
verses.en: Full lakes of butter with their banks of honey, flowing with wine, and milk and curds and water—Abundant with their overflow of sweetness, these streams shall reach thee in the world of Svarga, whole lakes with lotus-blossom shall approach thee.

verses.sa:
चतुरः कुम्भांश्चतुर्धा ददामि क्षीरेण पूर्नाँ उदकेन दध्ना।
एतास्त्वा धारा उप यन्तु सर्वाः स्वर्गे लोके मधुमत् पिन्वमाना उप त्वा तिष्ठन्तु पुष्करिणीः समन्ताः॥
verses.tr: caturaḥ kumbhāṃścaturdhā dadāmi kṣīreṇa pūrnāṃ udakena dadhnā etāstvā dhārā upa yantu sarvāḥ svarge loke madhumat pinvamānā upa tvā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samantāḥ
verses.en: I give four pitchers, in four several places, filled to the brim with milk and curds and water. Abundant with their overflow of sweetness, these streams shall reach thee in the world of Svarga, whole lakes with lotus-blossom shall approach thee.

verses.sa:
इममोदनं नि दधे ब्राह्मणेषु विष्टारिणं लोकजितं स्वर्गम्।
स मे मा क्षेष्ट स्वधया पिन्वमानो विश्वरूपा धेनुः कामदुघा मे अस्तु॥
verses.tr: imamodanaṃ ni dadhe brāhmaṇeṣu viṣṭāriṇaṃ lokajitaṃ svargam sa me mā kṣeṣṭa svadhayā pinvamāno viśvarūpā dhenuḥ kāmadughā me astu
verses.en: I part this Odana among the Brahmans, Vishtari, conquering worlds and reaching heaven. Let me not lose it: swelling by its nature, be it my perfect Cow to grant all wishes!

sections.label: A further magnification of the Odana
sections.name: Hymn 35

verses.sa:
बयमोदनं प्रथमजा ऋतस्य प्रजापतिस्तपसा ब्रह्मणेऽपचत्।
यो लोकानां विधृतिर्नाभिरेषात् तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम्॥
verses.tr: bayamodanaṃ prathamajā ṛtasya prajāpatistapasā brahmaṇe'pacat yo lokānāṃ vidhṛtirnābhireṣāt tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum
verses.en: Odana which Prajapati, the firstborn of Order, dressed with fervour for the Brahman, Which guards the worlds from breaking at the centre,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.

verses.sa:
येनातरन् भूतकृतोऽति मृत्युं यमन्वविदन् तपसा श्रमेण ।
यं पपाच ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्म पूर्वं तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम्॥
verses.tr: yenātaran bhūtakṛto'ti mṛtyuṃ yamanvavidan tapasā śrameṇa yaṃ papāca brahmaṇe brahma pūrvaṃ tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum
verses.en: Whereby the World-creators vanquished Mrityu, that which they found by fervour, toil and trouble, That which prayer first made ready for the Brahman,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.

verses.sa:
यो दाधार पृथिवीं विश्वभोजसं यो अन्तरिक्षमापृणाद् रसेन ।
यो अस्तभ्नाद् दिवमूर्ध्वो महिम्ना तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम्॥
verses.tr: yo dādhāra pṛthivīṃ viśvabhojasaṃ yo antarikṣamāpṛṇād rasena yo astabhnād divamūrdhvo mahimnā tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum
verses.en: That which upholds the Earth, the all-sustainer, that which hath filled air's middle realm with moisture, Which, raised on high in grandeur, stablished heaven,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.

verses.sa:
यस्मान्मासा निर्मितास्त्रिंशदराः संवत्सरो यस्मान्निर्मितो द्वादशारः ।
अहोरात्रा यं परियन्तो नापुस्तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम्॥
verses.tr: yasmānmāsā nirmitāstriṃśadarāḥ saṃvatsaro yasmānnirmito dvādaśāraḥ ahorātrā yaṃ pariyanto nāpustenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum
verses.en: From which the months with thirty spokes were moulded, from which the twelve-spoked year was formed and fashioned, Which circling day and night have ne'er o'ertaken,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.

verses.sa:
यः प्राणदः प्राणदवान् बभूव यस्मै लोका घृतवन्तः क्षरन्ति ।
ज्योतिष्मतीः प्रदिशो यस्य सर्वास्तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम्॥
verses.tr: yaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇadavān babhūva yasmai lokā ghṛtavantaḥ kṣaranti jyotiṣmatīḥ pradiśo yasya sarvāstenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum
verses.en: Which hath become breath-giver, life-bestower, to which the worlds flow full of oil and fatness, To whom belong all the refulgent regions,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.

verses.sa:
यस्मात् पक्वादमृतं संबभूव यो गायत्र्या अधिपतिर्बभूव ।
यस्मिन् वेदा निहिता विश्वरूपास्तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम्॥
verses.tr: yasmāt pakvādamṛtaṃ saṃbabhūva yo gāyatryā adhipatirbabhūva yasmin vedā nihitā viśvarūpāstenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum
verses.en: From which, matured, sprang Amrit into being, which hath become Gayatri' s lord and ruler, In which the perfect Vedas have been treasured,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.

verses.sa:
अव बाधे द्विषन्तं देवपीयुं सपत्ना ये मेऽप ते भवन्तु ।
ब्रह्मौदनं विश्वजितं पचामि शृण्वन्तु मे श्रद्दधानस्य देवाः॥
verses.tr: ava bādhe dviṣantaṃ devapīyuṃ sapatnā ye me'pa te bhavantu brahmaudanaṃ viśvajitaṃ pacāmi śṛṇvantu me śraddadhānasya devāḥ
verses.en: I drive away the hostile God-despiser: far off be those who are mine adversaries. I dress Brahmaudana that winneth all things. May the Gods hear me who believe and trust them.

sections.label: A charm against fiends, human enemies, and other pests
sections.name: Hymn 36

verses.sa:
तान्त्सत्यौजाः प्र दहत्वग्निर्वैश्वानरोवृषा ।
यो नो दुरस्याद् दिप्साच्चाथो यो नो अरातियात्॥
verses.tr: tāntsatyaujāḥ pra dahatvagnirvaiśvānarovṛṣā yo no durasyād dipsāccātho yo no arātiyāt
verses.en: Endowed with true strength, let the Bull, Agni Vaisvanara, burn them up, Him who would pain and injure us, him who would treat us as a foe.

verses.sa:
यो नो दिप्सददिप्सतो दिप्सतो यश्च दिप्सति ।
वैश्वानरस्य दंष्ट्रयोरग्नेरपि दधामि तम्॥
verses.tr: yo no dipsadadipsato dipsato yaśca dipsati vaiśvānarasya daṃṣṭrayoragnerapi dadhāmi tam
verses.en: Him who, unharmed, would injure us, and him who, harmed, would do us harm I lay between the doubled fangs of Agni, of Vaisvanara.

verses.sa:
य आगरे मृगयन्ते प्रतिक्रोशेऽमावास्ये।
क्रव्यादो अन्यान् दिप्सतः सर्वांस्तान्त्सहसा सहे॥
verses.tr: ya āgare mṛgayante pratikrośe'māvāsye kravyādo anyān dipsataḥ sarvāṃstāntsahasā sahe
verses.en: Those who, what time the moon is dark, hunt with loud cry and answering shout, Flesh-eaters, others who would harm,—all these I overcome with might.

verses.sa:
सहे पिशाचान्त्सहसैषां द्रविणं ददे ।
सर्वान् दुरस्यतो हन्मि सं म आकूतिरृद्यताम्॥
verses.tr: sahe piśācāntsahasaiṣāṃ draviṇaṃ dade sarvān durasyato hanmi saṃ ma ākūtirṛdyatām
verses.en: I conquer the Pisachas with my power, and take their wealth away. All who would injure us I slay. Let mine intention have success.

verses.sa:
ये देवास्तेन हासन्ते सूर्येण मिमते जवम्।
नदीषु पर्वतेषु ये सं तैः पशुभिर्विदे॥
verses.tr: ye devāstena hāsante sūryeṇa mimate javam nadīṣu parvateṣu ye saṃ taiḥ paśubhirvide
verses.en: With Gods who flee with him, and match their rapid motion with the Sun, I with those animals who dwell in rivers and on hills am found.

verses.sa:
तपनो अस्मि पिशाचानां व्याघ्रो गोमतामिव ।
श्वानः सिंहमिव दृष्ट्वा ते न विन्दन्ते न्यञ्चनम्॥
verses.tr: tapano asmi piśācānāṃ vyāghro gomatāmiva śvānaḥ siṃhamiva dṛṣṭvā te na vindante nyañcanam
verses.en: I trouble the Pisachas as the tiger plagues men rich in kine. They, even as dogs when they have seen a lion, find no hiding-place.

verses.sa:
न पिशाचैः सं शक्नोमि न स्तेनैर्न वनर्गुभिः ।
पिशाचास्तस्मान्नश्यन्ति यमहं ग्राममाविशे॥
verses.tr: na piśācaiḥ saṃ śaknomi na stenairna vanargubhiḥ piśācāstasmānnaśyanti yamahaṃ grāmamāviśe
verses.en: Naught with Pisachas can I do, with thieves, with roamers of the wood. Pisachas flee and vanish from each village as I enter it.

verses.sa:
यं ग्राममाविशत इदमुग्रं सहो मम ।
पिशाचास्तस्मान्नश्यन्ति न पापमुप जानते॥
verses.tr: yaṃ grāmamāviśata idamugraṃ saho mama piśācāstasmānnaśyanti na pāpamupa jānate
verses.en: Into whatever village this mine awful power penetrates, Thence the Pisachas flee away, and plot no further mischief there.

verses.sa:
ये मा क्रोधयन्ति लपिता हस्तिनं मशका इव ।
तानहं मन्ये दुर्हितान् जने अल्पशयूनिव॥
verses.tr: ye mā krodhayanti lapitā hastinaṃ maśakā iva tānahaṃ manye durhitān jane alpaśayūniva
verses.en: Those who enrage me with their plate, as flies torment an elephant, I deem unhappy creatures, like small insects troublesome to man.

verses.sa:
अभि तं निरृतिर्धत्तामश्वमिवाश्वाभिधान्या ।
मल्वो यो मह्यं क्रुध्यति स उ पाशान्नमुच्यते॥
verses.tr: abhi taṃ nirṛtirdhattāmaśvamivāśvābhidhānyā malvo yo mahyaṃ krudhyati sa u pāśānnamucyate
verses.en: Destruction seize upon the man, as with a cord they hold a horse, The fool who is enraged with me! He is not rescued from the noose.

sections.label: A charm against Gandharvas and Apsarases
sections.name: Hymn 37

verses.sa:
त्वया पूर्वमथर्वाणो जघ्नू रक्षांस्योषधे ।
त्वया जघान कश्यपस्त्वया कण्वो अगस्त्यः॥
verses.tr: tvayā pūrvamatharvāṇo jaghnū rakṣāṃsyoṣadhe tvayā jaghāna kaśyapastvayā kaṇvo agastyaḥ
verses.en: With thee, O Plant, in olden time Atharvans smote and slew the fiends. Kasyapa smote with thee, with thee did Kanva and Agastya smite.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयमप्सरसो गन्धर्वांस्चातयामहे ।
अजशृङ्ग्यज रक्षः सर्वान् गन्धेन नाशय॥
verses.tr: tvayā vayamapsaraso gandharvāṃscātayāmahe ajaśṛṅgyaja rakṣaḥ sarvān gandhena nāśaya
verses.en: With thee we scare and drive away Gandharvas and O Ajasringi, chase the fiends. Cause all to vanish. with thy smell.

verses.sa:
नदीं यन्त्वप्सरसोऽपां तारमवश्वसम्।
गुल्गुलूः पीला नलद्यौ३क्षगन्धिः प्रमन्दनी।
तत् परेताप्सरसः प्रतिबुद्धा अभूतन॥
verses.tr: nadīṃ yantvapsaraso'pāṃ tāramavaśvasam gulgulūḥ pīlā naladyau3kṣagandhiḥ pramandanī tat paretāpsarasaḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana
verses.en: Let the Apsarases, puffed away, go to the river, to the ford,—Guggulu, Pl! Naladi, Aukshagandhi, Pramandini. Ye have become attentive since the Apsarases have past away.

verses.sa:
यत्राश्वत्था न्यग्रोधा महावृक्षाः शिखण्डिनः ।
तत् परेताप्सरसः प्रतिबुद्धा अभूतन॥
verses.tr: yatrāśvatthā nyagrodhā mahāvṛkṣāḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ tat paretāpsarasaḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana
verses.en: Where great trees are, Asvattha and Nyagrodhas with their leafy crests, There where your swings are green and bright, and lutes and cymbals sound in tune, Ye have become attentive since the Apsarases have past away.

verses.sa:
यत्र वः प्रेङ्खा हरिता अर्जुना उत यत्राघाताः कर्कर्यः संवदन्ति ।
तत् परेताप्सरसः प्रतिबुद्धा अभूतन॥
verses.tr: yatra vaḥ preṅkhā haritā arjunā uta yatrāghātāḥ karkaryaḥ saṃvadanti tat paretāpsarasaḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana
verses.en: Hither hath come this one, the most effectual of herbs. and plants.

verses.sa:
एयमगन्नोषधीनां वीरुधां वीर्याऽवती ।
अजशृङ्ग्यऽराटकी तीक्ष्णशृङ्गी व्यृऽषतु॥
verses.tr: eyamagannoṣadhīnāṃ vīrudhāṃ vīryā'vatī ajaśṛṅgya'rāṭakī tīkṣṇaśṛṅgī vyṛ'ṣatu
verses.en: Let Ajasringi penetrate, Aramati with sharpened horn.

verses.sa:
आनृत्यतः शिखण्डिनो गन्धर्वस्याप्सरापतेः ।
भिनद्मि मुष्कावपि यामि शेपः॥
verses.tr: ānṛtyataḥ śikhaṇḍino gandharvasyāpsarāpateḥ bhinadmi muṣkāvapi yāmi śepaḥ
verses.en: From the Gandharva, dancing near, the lord of the Apsarases, Wearing the tuft of hair, I take all manhood and virility.

verses.sa:
भीमा इन्द्रस्य हेतयः शतमृष्टीरयस्मयीः ।
ताभिर्हविरदान् गन्धर्वानवकादान् व्यृऽषतु॥
verses.tr: bhīmā indrasya hetayaḥ śatamṛṣṭīrayasmayīḥ tābhirhaviradān gandharvānavakādān vyṛ'ṣatu
verses.en: With those dread hundred iron spears, the darts of Indra, let it pierce The Blyxa-fed Gandharvas, those who bring no sacrificial gift.

verses.sa:
भीमा इन्द्रस्य हेतयः शतमृष्टीर्हिरण्ययीः ।
ताभिर्हविरदान् गन्धर्वानवकादान् व्युऽषतु॥
verses.tr: bhīmā indrasya hetayaḥ śatamṛṣṭīrhiraṇyayīḥ tābhirhaviradān gandharvānavakādān vyu'ṣatu
verses.en: With those dread hundred golden spears, the darts of Indra, let it pierce The Blyxa-fed Gandharvas, those who bring no sacrificial gift.

verses.sa:
अवकादानभिशोचानप्सु ज्योतय मामकान्।
पिशाचान्त्सर्वानोषधे प्र मृणीहि सहस्व च॥
verses.tr: avakādānabhiśocānapsu jyotaya māmakān piśācāntsarvānoṣadhe pra mṛṇīhi sahasva ca
verses.en: O Plant, be thou victorious, crush the Pisachas, one and all, Blyxa-fed, shining in the floods, illumining the selfish ones.

verses.sa:
स्वेवैकः कपिरिवैकः कुमारः सर्वकेशकः ।
प्रियो दृश इव भूत्वा गन्धर्वः सचते स्त्रियस्तमितो नाशयामसि ब्रह्मणा वीर्याऽवता॥
verses.tr: svevaikaḥ kapirivaikaḥ kumāraḥ sarvakeśakaḥ priyo dṛśa iva bhūtvā gandharvaḥ sacate striyastamito nāśayāmasi brahmaṇā vīryā'vatā
verses.en: Youthful, completely decked with hair, one monkey-like, one like a dog,—l So the Gandharva, putting on a lovely look, pursues. a dame, Him with an efficacious charm we scare and cause to vanish hence.

verses.sa:
जाया इद् वो अप्सरसो गन्धर्वाः पतयो यूयम्।
अप धावतामर्त्या मर्त्यान् मा सचध्वम्॥
verses.tr: jāyā id vo apsaraso gandharvāḥ patayo yūyam apa dhāvatāmartyā martyān mā sacadhvam
verses.en: Your wives are the Apsarases, and ye, Gandharvas, are their lords. Run ye, immortal ones, away: forbear to interfere with men!

sections.label: A charm for success in gambling
sections.name: Hymn 38

verses.sa:
उद्भिन्दतीं संजयन्तीमप्सरां साधुदेविनीम्।
ग्लहे कृतानि कृण्वानामप्सरां तामिह हुवे॥
verses.tr: udbhindatīṃ saṃjayantīmapsarāṃ sādhudevinīm glahe kṛtāni kṛṇvānāmapsarāṃ tāmiha huve
verses.en: Hither I call the Apsaras, victorious, who plays with skill, Her who comes freely forth to view, who wins the stakes in games of dice.

verses.sa:
विचिन्वतीमाकिरन्तीमप्सरां साधुदेविनीम्।
ग्लहे कृतानि गृह्णानामप्सरां तामिह हुवे॥
verses.tr: vicinvatīmākirantīmapsarāṃ sādhudevinīm glahe kṛtāni gṛhṇānāmapsarāṃ tāmiha huve
verses.en: Hither I call that Apsaras who scatters and who gathers up, The Apsaras who plays with skill and takes her winnings in the game.

verses.sa:
यायैः परिनृत्यत्याददाना कृतं ग्लहात्।
सा नः कृतानि सीषती प्रहामाप्नोतु मायया ।
सा नः पयस्वत्यैतु मा नो जैषुरिदं धनम्॥
verses.tr: yāyaiḥ parinṛtyatyādadānā kṛtaṃ glahāt sā naḥ kṛtāni sīṣatī prahāmāpnotu māyayā sā naḥ payasvatyaitu mā no jaiṣuridaṃ dhanam
verses.en: Dancing around us with the dice, winning the wager by her play, May she obtain the stake for us and gain the victory with skill. May she approach us full of strength: let them not win this wealth of ours.

verses.sa:
या अक्षेषु प्रमोदन्ते शुचं क्रोधं च बिभ्रती ।
आनन्दिनीं प्रमोदिनीमप्सरां तामिह हुवे॥
verses.tr: yā akṣeṣu pramodante śucaṃ krodhaṃ ca bibhratī ānandinīṃ pramodinīmapsarāṃ tāmiha huve
verses.en: Hither I call that Apsaras, the joyous, the delightful one—Those nymphs who revel in the dice, who suffer grief and yield to wrath.

verses.sa:
सूर्यस्य रश्मीननु याः सञ्चरन्ति मरीचीर्वा या अनुसञ्चरन्ति ।
यासामृषभो दूरतो वाजिनीवान्त्सद्यः सर्वाँन् लोकान् पर्यैति रक्षन्।
स न ऐतु होममिमं जुषाणो३ऽन्तरिक्षेण सह वाजिनीवान्॥
verses.tr: sūryasya raśmīnanu yāḥ sañcaranti marīcīrvā yā anusañcaranti yāsāmṛṣabho dūrato vājinīvāntsadyaḥ sarvāṃn lokān paryaiti rakṣan sa na aitu homamimaṃ juṣāṇo3'ntarikṣeṇa saha vājinīvān
verses.en: Who follow in their course the rays of Surya, or as a particle of light attend him. Whose leader from afar, with store of riches, compasses quickly all the worlds and guards them. Pleased, may he come to this our burnt oblation, together with the Air, enriched with treasure.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षेन सह वाजिनीवन् कर्कीं वत्सामिह रक्ष वाजिन्।
इमे ते स्तोका बहुला एह्यर्वाङियं ते कर्कीह ते मनोऽस्तु॥
verses.tr: antarikṣena saha vājinīvan karkīṃ vatsāmiha rakṣa vājin ime te stokā bahulā ehyarvāṅiyaṃ te karkīha te mano'stu
verses.en: Together with the Air, O rich in treasure, guard 'here the white cow and the calf, O mighty! Here are abundant drops for thee, come hither! Here is thy white calf, let thy mind be with us.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षेण सह वाजिनीवन् कर्कीं वत्सामिह रक्ष वाजिन्।
अयं घासो अयं व्रज इह वत्सां नि बध्नीमः ।
यथानाम व ईश्महे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: antarikṣeṇa saha vājinīvan karkīṃ vatsāmiha rakṣa vājin ayaṃ ghāso ayaṃ vraja iha vatsāṃ ni badhnīmaḥ yathānāma va īśmahe svāhā
verses.en: Together with the Air, O rich in treasure, keep the white calf in safety here, O mighty! Here is the grass, here is the stall, here do we bind the calf. We are your masters, name by name. All Hail!

sections.label: A prayer to various deities for health, wealth, and prosperity
sections.name: Hymn 39

verses.sa:
पृथिव्यामग्नये समनमन्त्स आर्ध्नोत्।
यथा पृथिव्यामग्नये समनमन्नेवा मह्यं संनमः सं नमन्तु॥
verses.tr: pṛthivyāmagnaye samanamantsa ārdhnot yathā pṛthivyāmagnaye samanamannevā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu
verses.en: Agni on earth hath had mine homage. May he bless me. As I have bowed me down to Agni on the earth, so let the Favouring Graces bow them down to me.

verses.sa:
पृथिवी धेनुस्तस्या अग्निर्वत्सः ।
सा मेऽग्निना वत्सेनेषमूर्जं कामं दुहाम्।
आयुः प्रथमं प्रजां पोषं रयिं स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: pṛthivī dhenustasyā agnirvatsaḥ sā me'gninā vatseneṣamūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā
verses.en: Earth is the Cow, her calf is Agni. May she with her calf Agni yield me food, strength, all my wish, life first of all; and offspring, plenty, wealth. All Hail!

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षे वायवे समनमन्त्स आर्ध्नोत्।
यथान्तरिक्षे वायवे समनमन्नेवा मह्यं संनमः सं नमन्तु॥
verses.tr: antarikṣe vāyave samanamantsa ārdhnot yathāntarikṣe vāyave samanamannevā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu
verses.en: Vayu in air hath had mine homage. May he bless me. As I have bowed me down to Vayu in the air, so let the Favouring Graces bow them down to me.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षं धेनुस्तस्या वायुर्वत्सः ।
सा मे वायुना वत्सेनेषमूर्जं कामं दुहाम्।
आयुः प्रथमं प्रजां पोषं रयिं स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: antarikṣaṃ dhenustasyā vāyurvatsaḥ sā me vāyunā vatseneṣamūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā
verses.en: Air is the Cow, her calf is Vayu. May she with her calf Vayu yield me food, strength, all my wish, life first of all, and offspring, plenty, wealth. All ail! Hail!

verses.sa:
दिव्याऽदित्याय समनमन्त्स आर्ध्नोत्।
यथा दिव्याऽदित्याय समनमन्नेवा मह्यं संनमः सं नमन्तु॥
verses.tr: divyā'dityāya samanamantsa ārdhnot yathā divyā'dityāya samanamannevā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu
verses.en: The Sun in heaven hath had my homage. May he bless me. As I have bowed me down unto the Sun in heaven, so let the Favouring Graces bow them down to me,

verses.sa:
द्यैर्धेनुस्तस्या आदित्यो वत्सः ।
सा म आदित्येन वत्सेनेषमूर्जं कामं दुहाम्।
आयुः प्रथमं प्रजां पोषं रयिं स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: dyairdhenustasyā ādityo vatsaḥ sā ma ādityena vatseneṣamūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā
verses.en: Heaven is the Cow, her calf Aditya. May she yield with her calf the Sun food, strength, and all my wish, life first of all, and offspring, plenty, wealth. A Hail!

verses.sa:
दिक्षु चन्द्राय समनमन्त्स आर्ध्नोत्।
यथा दिक्षु चन्द्राय समनमन्नेवा मह्यं संनमः सं नमन्तु॥
verses.tr: dikṣu candrāya samanamantsa ārdhnot yathā dikṣu candrāya samanamannevā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu
verses.en: To Chandra in the quarters have I bowed me. May he bless me. As unto Chandra in the quarters I have bent, so let the Favouring Graces bow them down to me.

verses.sa:
दिशो धेनवस्तासां चन्द्रो वत्सः ।
ता मे चन्द्रेण वत्सेनेषमूर्जं कामं दुहाम् ।
आयुः प्रथमं प्रजां पोषं रयिं स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: diśo dhenavastāsāṃ candro vatsaḥ tā me candreṇa vatseneṣamūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā
verses.en: The quarters are the Cows, their calf is Chandra. May they yield with their calf the Moon food, strength, and all my wish, life first of all, and offspring, plenty, wealth. All Hail!

verses.sa:
अग्नावग्निश्चरति प्रविष्ट ऋषीणां पुत्रो अभिशस्तिपा उ ।
नमस्कारेण नमसा ते जुहोमि मा देवानां मिथुया कर्म भागम्॥
verses.tr: agnāvagniścarati praviṣṭa ṛṣīṇāṃ putro abhiśastipā u namaskāreṇa namasā te juhomi mā devānāṃ mithuyā karma bhāgam
verses.en: Agni moves having entered into Agni, the Rishis' son, who guards from imprecations. I offer unto thee with reverent worship. Let me not mar the Gods' appointed service.

verses.sa:
हृदा पूतं मनसा जातवेदो विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान्।
सप्तास्यानि तव जातवेदस्तेभ्यो जुहोमि स जुषस्व हव्यम्॥
verses.tr: hṛdā pūtaṃ manasā jātavedo viśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān saptāsyāni tava jātavedastebhyo juhomi sa juṣasva havyam
verses.en: Skilled in all ways, O God, O Jatavedas, I offer what is cleansed by heart and spirit To all thy seven mouths, O Jatavedas. Do thou accept with pleasure my libation.

sections.label: A charm against rival worshippers
sections.name: Hymn 40

verses.sa:
ये पुरस्ताज्जुह्वति जातवेदः प्राच्या दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान्।
अग्निमृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि॥
verses.tr: ye purastājjuhvati jātavedaḥ prācyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān agnimṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi
verses.en: O Jatavedas, eastward sacrificers, as foes assail us from the eastern quarter. May they, turned back, be pained for harming Agni. I drive them backward with mine incantation.

verses.sa:
ये दक्षिणतो जुह्वति जातवेदो दक्षिणाया दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान्।
यममृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि॥
verses.tr: ye dakṣiṇato juhvati jātavedo dakṣiṇāyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān yamamṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi
verses.en: O Jatavedas, southward sacrificers as foes assail us from the southern quarter. May they, turned back, be pained for harming Yama. I smite them backward with mine incantation.

verses.sa:
ये पश्चाज्जुह्वति जातवेदः प्रतीच्या दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान्।
वरुणमृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि॥
verses.tr: ye paścājjuhvati jātavedaḥ pratīcyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān varuṇamṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi
verses.en: O Jatavedas, westward sacrificers as foes assail us from the western quarter. For harming Varuna be they turned and troubled! I smite them backward with mine incantation.

verses.sa:
य उत्तरतो जुह्वति जातवेद उदीच्या दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान्।
सोममृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि॥
verses.tr: ya uttarato juhvati jātaveda udīcyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān somamṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi
verses.en: O Jatavedas, northward sacrificers as foes assail us from the northern quarter. For harming Soma he they turned and troubled! I smite them backward with mine incantation.

verses.sa:
ये३धस्ताज्जुह्वति जातवेदो ध्रुवाया दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान्।
भूमिमृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि॥
verses.tr: ye3dhastājjuhvati jātavedo dhruvāyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān bhūmimṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi
verses.en: O Jatavedas, nether sacrificers as foes assail us from the stedfast quarter. For harming Earth let them he turned and troubled. I smite them backward with mine incantation.

verses.sa:
ये३ऽन्तरिक्षाज्जुह्वति जातवेदो व्यध्वाया दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान्।
वायुमृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि॥
verses.tr: ye3'ntarikṣājjuhvati jātavedo vyadhvāyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān vāyumṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi
verses.en: Those who pay sacrifice, O Jatavedas, from air assail us from the midway quarter. For harming Vayu be they turned and troubled! I smite them backward with mine incantation.

verses.sa:
य उपरिष्टाज्जुह्वति जातवेद ऊर्ध्वाया दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान्।
सूर्यमृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि॥
verses.tr: ya upariṣṭājjuhvati jātaveda ūrdhvāyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān sūryamṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi
verses.en: The sacrificers from above assail us, O Jatavedas, from the lofty quarter. For wronging Surya be they turned and troubled! I smite them backward with mine incantation.

verses.sa:
ये दिशामन्तर्देशेभ्यो जुह्वति जातवेदः सर्वाभ्यो दिग्भ्योऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान्।
ब्रह्मर्त्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि॥
verses.tr: ye diśāmantardeśebhyo juhvati jātavedaḥ sarvābhyo digbhyo'bhidāsantyasmān brahmartvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi
verses.en: Those from all points assail us, Jatavedas, who sacrifice from intermediate regions. For wronging Prayer let them be turned and troubled. I smite them backward with mine incantation.
